carrefour-group.name: Carrefour Group
carrefour-group.description: Carrefour Group is a French multinational retail and wholesaling corporation headquartered in Massy, France. It operates a chain of hypermarkets, grocery stores, and convenience stores. By 2024, Carrefour had 14,000 stores in 40 countries and was the seventh-largest retailer in the world by revenue.

china-construction-bank.name: China Construction Bank
china-construction-bank.description: China Construction Bank is a Chinese partially state-owned multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Beijing. It is one of the "big four" banks in China and the third largest bank in the world by total assets. The bank has numerous domestic and overseas branches.

china-telecommunications-corporation.name: China Telecommunications Corporation
china-telecommunications-corporation.description: China Telecommunications Corporation is a Chinese state-owned telecommunication conglomerate. It is the principal landline telecommunication provider and the second-largest mobile telecommunication provider in China.

cvs-health.name: CVS Health
cvs-health.description: CVS Health Corporation is an American multinational healthcare company that owns CVS Pharmacy, CVS Caremark, and Aetna. It is the world's second largest healthcare company and was founded in Lowell, Massachusetts. The name CVS originally stood for Consumer Value Stores.

citic-limited.name: CITIC Limited
citic-limited.description: CITIC Limited is a Hong Kong-based conglomerate listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and part of the Hang Seng Index. The Chinese state-owned CITIC Group owns 58% of its shares. It operates as a diversified holding company.

china-railway-group-limited.name: China Railway Group Limited
china-railway-group-limited.description: China Railway Group Limited (CREC) is a Chinese construction company traded on the Shanghai and Hong Kong stock exchanges. Its major shareholder is the state-owned China Railway Engineering Corporation. The company operates primarily in construction.

china-telecom.name: China Telecom
china-telecom.description: China Telecom Corporation Limited, known as China Telecom, is a major Chinese telecommunications company. It is the principal landline service provider and the second-largest mobile telecommunication provider in China.

cognizant-technology-solutions.name: Cognizant Technology Solutions
cognizant-technology-solutions.description: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation is an American domiciled Indian multinational IT services and outsourcing company headquartered in Teaneck, New Jersey. It was founded in Chennai, India in 1994 as part of Dun & Bradstreet and went public in 1998.

china-railway-construction-corporation-l.name: China Railway Construction Corporation Limited
china-railway-construction-corporation-l.description: China Railway Construction Corporation Limited is a Beijing-based listed construction enterprise. It was the second largest construction and engineering company in the world by revenue in 2014.

citigroup.name: Citigroup
citigroup.description: Citigroup Inc., or Citi, is an American multinational investment bank and financial services company based in New York City. It was formed in 1998 by the merger of Citicorp and Travelers, with Travelers spun off in 2002.

continental-ag.name: Continental AG
continental-ag.description: Continental AG is a German multinational manufacturer of tires and industrial rubber and thermoplastic products. Founded in 1871, it is headquartered in Hanover, Lower Saxony, and ranked fourth worldwide by tire sales in 2025.

china-north-industries-group-corporation.name: China North Industries Group Corporation Limited
china-north-industries-group-corporation.legal_name: China North Industries Group Corporation Limited
china-north-industries-group-corporation.description: China North Industries Group Corporation Limited, known as Norinco Group, is a Chinese state-owned defense corporation manufacturing commercial and military products. It is one of the world's largest defense contractors.

listings.name: China North Industries Group Corporation Limited

canon-inc.name: Canon Inc.
canon-inc.description: Canon Inc. is a Japanese multinational corporation headquartered in Ōta, Tokyo. It specializes in optical, imaging, and industrial products including cameras, lenses, medical equipment, scanners, printers, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

crrc.name: CRRC
crrc.description: CRRC Corporation Limited is a Chinese state-owned and publicly traded rolling stock manufacturer. It is the world's largest rolling stock manufacturer by revenue, surpassing competitors like Alstom and Siemens.

credit-agricole-group.name: Credit Agricole Group
credit-agricole-group.description: Crédit Agricole Group is a French international banking group known as La banque verte. It is the world's largest cooperative financial institution.

china-life-insurance-company.name: China Life Insurance Company
china-life-insurance-company.description: China Life Insurance Company Limited is a life insurance provider headquartered in Beijing, China. It is the largest life insurer in China by market share as of April 2023 and was ranked 62nd in the Forbes Global 2000 in 2023. The company offers life insurance and annuity products.

cgi-group.name: CGI Group
cgi-group.description: CGI is a multinational information technology consulting and software development company headquartered in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. It went public in 1986 and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and New York Stock Exchange. CGI operates in information technology consulting.

china-shenhua-energy-company.name: China Shenhua Energy Company
china-shenhua-energy-company.description: China Shenhua Energy Company Limited is the largest state-owned coal mining enterprise in mainland China and the world. It operates coal mines, an integrated railway network, a seaport, and power plants primarily in the People's Republic of China. It is a subsidiary of Shenhua Group.

cisco.name: Cisco
cisco.description: Cisco Systems, Inc., known as Cisco, is an American multinational technology conglomerate headquartered in San Jose, California. It develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment, and other high-technology products focused on networking, cybersecurity, and AI.

china-taiping-insurance-holdings.name: China Taiping Insurance Holdings
china-taiping-insurance-holdings.description: China Taiping Insurance Holdings Company Limited is a Chinese insurance conglomerate incorporated in Hong Kong with strong Chinese Central Government background. It is considered a red chip company.

crh.name: CRH
crh.description: CRH plc is an American-Irish building materials provider headquartered in Dublin and New York. It produces construction materials such as aggregates, cement, ready-mixed concrete, and asphalt concrete. CRH operates nearly 4,000 locations across 28 countries including North America, Europe, Australia, and the Philippines.

country-garden.name: Country Garden
country-garden.description: Country Garden is a real estate development company headquartered in Shunde, Foshan, Guangdong, China. It is owned by the family of Yang Guoqiang. The company operates in the real estate sector in China.

china-unicom.name: China Unicom
china-unicom.description: China United Network Communications Group Co., Ltd., known as China Unicom, is a Chinese state-owned telecommunications operator founded in 1994. It provides mobile network, calling, data communication, internet services, digital television, and IP telephony. It is the third-largest wireless carrier in China and sixth largest worldwide.

corning-inc.name: Corning Inc.
corning-inc.description: Corning Incorporated is an American multinational technology company specializing in glass, ceramics, and related materials for industrial and scientific applications. Founded in 1851 as Corning Glass Works, it was known for consumer products like CorningWare and Pyrex before divesting these lines in 1998.

chipotle-mexican-grill.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill
chipotle-mexican-grill.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. is an American multinational fast casual restaurant chain specializing in bowls, tacos, and Mission burritos made to order. The name Chipotle comes from the Nahuatl word for a smoked and dried jalapeño chili pepper. As of December 2025, it operates 4,000 locations.

cencora.name: Cencora
cencora.description: Cencora, Inc., formerly AmerisourceBergen, is an American drug wholesale and distribution company and contract research organization. Headquartered in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania, it distributes generic pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter healthcare products, and home healthcare supplies.

china-hongqiao.name: China Hongqiao
china-hongqiao.description: China Hongqiao Group Limited is one of the world's largest producers of primary aluminium. It is headquartered in Binzhou, Shandong Province, China, and registered in Hong Kong. The company grew from a textile background in the 1990s to become the second largest aluminium producer globally since 2015.

centrica.name: Centrica
centrica.description: Centrica plc is a British multinational energy and services company headquartered in Windsor, Berkshire, England. It operates in the energy supply industry.

carlsberg-group.name: Carlsberg Group
carlsberg-group.description: Carlsberg A/S is a Danish multinational brewer headquartered in Copenhagen. Founded in 1847, it is majority-owned by the Carlsberg Foundation and is the seventh largest brewery in the world by revenue.

cleveland-cliffs.name: Cleveland-Cliffs
cleveland-cliffs.description: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is an American steel manufacturer based in Cleveland, Ohio. It specializes in mining, beneficiation, and pelletizing of iron ore, as well as steelmaking including stamping and tooling. It is the largest flat-rolled steel producer in North America and the second-largest steel producer in the United States.

colruyt-group.name: Colruyt Group
colruyt-group.industry: Retail sale in non-specialised stores with food, beverages or tobacco predominating
colruyt-group.description: Colruyt Group is a Belgian family-owned retail corporation managing Colruyt supermarkets and subsidiaries like OKay, Bio-Planet, DATS 24, and Spar. It operates in the retail sector focusing on food, beverages, and tobacco.

carvana.name: Carvana
carvana.description: Carvana Co. is an American online car retailer based in Tempe, Arizona. It was named to the 2021 Fortune 500 list, making it one of the youngest companies to be added to the list.

corteva.name: Corteva
corteva.industry: Pesticide and Other Agricultural Chemical Manufacturing
corteva.description: Corteva, Inc. is an American company focused on products for seeds and crop protection, including herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and biologicals sold in 110 countries. It is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, and its primary brand is Pioneer Hi-Bred International.

caci.name: CACI
caci.description: CACI International Inc. is an American multinational aerospace and defense company headquartered in Northern Virginia. It provides services to various branches of the US federal government including defense, homeland security, and intelligence.

chiquita-brands-international.name: Chiquita Brands International
chiquita-brands-international.description: Chiquita Brands International S.à.r.l. is a Swiss company that produces and distributes bananas and other produce. It operates under subsidiary brand names such as Chiquita and Fresh Express salads and is among the leading banana distributors worldwide.

citizen-watch.name: Citizen Watch
citizen-watch.description: Citizen Watch Co., Ltd. is a Japanese precision-equipment manufacturer and holding company of the Citizen Group. Headquartered in Nishitōkyō, Tokyo, it operates in watches, machine tools, and devices and components segments. It is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

covestro.name: Covestro
covestro.description: Covestro AG is a German company that produces polyurethane and polycarbonate raw materials. It offers products such as isocyanates, polyols for cellular foams, thermoplastic polyurethane, and additives for coatings and adhesives. Covestro was formed as a spin-off from Bayer in 2015 and was formerly known as Bayer MaterialScience.

citizens-financial-group.name: Citizens Financial Group
citizens-financial-group.description: Citizens Financial Group, Inc. is an American bank holding company headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island. It owns Citizens Bank, N.A., which operates in multiple U.S. states including Connecticut, Florida, and New York, among others.

cushman-wakefield.name: Cushman & Wakefield
cushman-wakefield.description: Cushman & Wakefield is a global commercial real estate services firm headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It provides services to occupiers and investors with operations in leasing, capital markets, valuation, and advisory services across nearly 60 countries.

charles-schwab-corporation.name: Charles Schwab Corporation
charles-schwab-corporation.description: The Charles Schwab Corporation is an American multinational financial services company headquartered in Westlake, Texas. It offers banking, investing, and wealth management services to retail and institutional clients, operating over 380 branches mainly in the US and UK.

china-airlines.name: China Airlines
china-airlines.description: China Airlines is the state-owned flag carrier of Taiwan, headquartered at Taoyuan International Airport. It operates over 1,400 weekly flights to 102 cities worldwide and is one of Taiwan's three major airlines. The airline carries millions of passengers and significant cargo annually.

curtiss-wright.name: Curtiss-Wright
curtiss-wright.description: The Curtiss-Wright Corporation is an American manufacturer and services provider headquartered in Davidson, North Carolina. Founded in 1929, it was the largest U.S. aviation firm and produced over 142,000 aircraft engines for the military during World War II.

china-steel-corporation.name: China Steel Corporation
china-steel-corporation.description: China Steel Corporation is the largest integrated steel maker in Taiwan, with its main steel mill located in Siaogang District, Kaohsiung. It is part of the CSC Group and was the 23rd largest steel producer worldwide in 2016.

casio.name: Casio
casio.description: Casio Computer Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational electronics manufacturer headquartered in Shibuya, Tokyo. Its principal products include watches, clocks, calculators, electronic dictionaries, label printers, and electronic musical instruments.

china-high-speed-transmission.name: China High Speed Transmission
china-high-speed-transmission.description: China High Speed Transmission Equipment Group Company, Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer of high-speed gear transmission equipment. It is the largest wind power transmission gear manufacturer in China.

china-merchants-port.name: China Merchants Port
china-merchants-port.description: China Merchants Port Holdings Company Limited is a Hong Kong-based conglomerate involved in port operations, cargo transportation, container shipping, air cargo, logistics parks, and paint products. It has port facilities in mainland China and Hong Kong and traces its origins to 1872.

commercial-metals-company.name: Commercial Metals Company
commercial-metals-company.description: Commercial Metals Company (CMC) is a producer of rebar and related construction materials headquartered in Irving, Texas. It is one of the two primary suppliers of steel used to reinforce concrete in U.S. infrastructure. The company also owns Tensar, which produces foundation systems for construction projects.

citrix-systems.name: Citrix Systems
citrix-systems.description: Citrix Systems, Inc. is an American multinational company specializing in cloud computing and virtualization technology. It provides server, application, and desktop virtualization, networking, SaaS, and cloud computing technologies. Its products are used by over 400,000 clients worldwide, including most Fortune 100 and Fortune 500 companies.

celanese-corporation.name: Celanese Corporation
celanese-corporation.description: Celanese Corporation is an American technology and specialty materials company headquartered in Irving, Texas. It is the world's leading producer of acetic acid and the largest producer of vinyl acetate monomer.

constellium.name: Constellium
constellium.description: Constellium SE is a French manufacturer and recycler of aluminium rolled and extruded products as well as structural components. It primarily serves the aerospace, automotive, and packaging industries.

cyrela-brazil-realty.name: Cyrela Brazil Realty
cyrela-brazil-realty.description: Cyrela Brazil Realty is the largest homebuilder and real estate company by revenue and market value in Brazil. Founded in 1962 and headquartered in São Paulo, it operates in 16 states and 66 cities in Brazil, as well as in Argentina and Uruguay.

crowdstrike.name: CrowdStrike
crowdstrike.description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. is an American cybersecurity technology company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Founded in 2011, it provides endpoint security, threat intelligence, and cyberattack response services. The company went public on Nasdaq in 2019 and joined the S&P 500 in 2024.

canal-s-a.name: Canal+ S.A.
canal-s-a.industry: Production de films et de programmes pour la télévision
canal-s-a.description: Canal+ S.A. is a French media and telecommunications conglomerate based in Paris. It operates subscription TV channels and an over-the-top video on-demand service, and is a major financier of domestic film production in France. It was a subsidiary of Vivendi until December 2024 and remains partly controlled by the Bolloré family.

cellcom-israel-ltd.name: Cellcom Israel Ltd.
cellcom-israel-ltd.description: Cellcom is an Israeli telecommunications company founded in 1994. Its business primarily focuses on wireless services. As of June 2016, the company had 2.812 million subscribers and its current CEO is Eli Adadi.

camping-world.name: Camping World
camping-world.description: Camping World Holdings, Inc. is an American company based in Lincolnshire, Illinois, specializing in selling recreational vehicles, parts, and camping supplies. It operates 202 locations and sells goods through dealerships, phone orders, and online. It claims to be the world's largest supplier of RV parts and supplies.

chugai-pharmaceutical-co.name: Chugai Pharmaceutical Co.
chugai-pharmaceutical-co.description: Chugai Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a Japanese drug manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. It is a subsidiary controlled by Hoffmann-La Roche, which owns 62% of the company. The company is led by Osamu Nagayama and Tatsuro Kosaka.

comarch.name: Comarch
comarch.description: Comarch is a Polish multinational software house and systems integrator based in Kraków. It provides services in telecommunications, finance, and other sectors, including ERP systems, IT security, CRM, and cloud solutions.

cpi-property-group.name: CPI Property Group
cpi-property-group.description: CPI Property Group is a real estate landlord focusing on commercial properties in the Czech Republic, Berlin, Warsaw, and Central & Eastern Europe. Founded in 1991 in the Czech Republic, it operates primarily in the real estate sector.

cewe.name: CeWe
cewe.description: Cewe is a German printing company based in Oldenburg, Lower Saxony, founded in 1961. It is the largest photo printing company in Europe, focusing mainly on digital printing of photos, photo books, and calendars.

capcom.name: Capcom
capcom.description: Capcom Co., Ltd. is a Japanese video game company based in Osaka. Established in 1983, it has created multiple successful game franchises and operates internationally with subsidiaries in East Asia, Europe, and North America.

cts-eventim-ag-co-kgaa.name: CTS EVENTIM AG & Co. KGaA
cts-eventim-ag-co-kgaa.description: CTS Eventim is a German company headquartered in Bremen that operates in the leisure-events market. It specializes in ticketing and live entertainment and is part of the MDAX index.

cheboksary-khimprom.name: Cheboksary Khimprom
cheboksary-khimprom.description: Khimprom Novocheboksarsk is a chemicals-producing company based in Novocheboksarsk, Russia. It is part of the Orgsintez Group, which is associated with Renova. The company operates in the chemical industry.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.description: Cloudflare, Inc. is an American technology company based in San Francisco, California. It provides internet services including content delivery network, cloud cybersecurity, DDoS mitigation, and domain registration. Its services act as a reverse proxy to improve website performance and security.

chr-hansen-holding.name: Chr. Hansen Holding
chr-hansen-holding.description: Chr. Hansen A/S was a biotechnology company based in Hørsholm, Denmark, supplying bacteria cultures, probiotics, enzymes, and human milk oligosaccharides. Its products are used in food production, dietary supplements, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture. In 2024, it merged with Novozymes to form Novonesis.

csr-limited.name: CSR Limited
csr-limited.description: CSR Pty Ltd is an Australian industrial company producing building products and holding a 25% share in the Tomago aluminium smelter near Newcastle, New South Wales. It is a subsidiary of Compagnie de Saint-Gobain S.A. and headquartered in North Ryde, Sydney.

cloetta.name: Cloetta
cloetta.description: Cloetta AB is a Swedish confectionery company that manufactures and sells local confectionery brands. Its main markets include Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, Germany, and the UK.

ci-t.name: CI&T
ci-t.description: CI&T is a Brazilian company specializing in information technology and software development. It operates within the technology sector and is based in Brazil.

cielo-s-a.name: Cielo S.A.
cielo-s-a.description: Cielo is the largest Brazilian credit and debit card operator, offering multi-brand acquiring solutions including credit, debit, and Pix transaction processing. It is the biggest payment system company in Latin America by revenue and market value.

carlyle-group.name: Carlyle Group
carlyle-group.description: The Carlyle Group Inc. is an American multinational company engaged in private equity, alternative asset management, and financial services. As of 2023, it managed assets totaling $426 billion.

cme-group.name: CME Group
cme-group.description: CME Group Inc., headquartered in Chicago, operates exchanges and clearing services for financial derivatives trading. Its exchanges include CME, CBOT, NYMEX, and COMEX, and it owns 27% of S&P Dow Jones Indices. It also operates electronic trading platforms serving customers globally.

colt-cz-group.name: Colt CZ Group
colt-cz-group.description: Colt CZ Group SE is a Czech holding company based in Prague owning firearms manufacturers Česká zbrojovka and Colt, and ammunition maker Sellier & Bellot. It sells firearms and ammunition to armed forces, police, hunters, and sport shooters. Its business Synthesia Nitrocellulose produces nitrocellulose for ammunition and industrial uses.

cetin.name: CETIN
cetin.description: CETIN a.s. is a Czech wholesale telecommunications infrastructure company headquartered in Prague. It owns and operates fixed and mobile networks in the Czech Republic and provides services to telecommunications operators. The company is wholly owned by CETIN Group N.V., itself owned by PPF Group.

coeur-mining.name: Coeur Mining
coeur-mining.description: Coeur Mining, Inc. is a precious metals mining company listed on the New York Stock Exchange. It operates five mines in North America and moved its head office to Chicago, Illinois in 2013. The company was formerly known as Coeur d'Alene Mines.

clas-ohlson.name: Clas Ohlson
clas-ohlson.description: Clas Ohlson is a Swedish home improvement chain and mail-order firm specializing in hardware, home, leisure, electrical, and multimedia products. It operates more than 230 stores in Scandinavia, including Norway and Finland. Many products sold are own-label items under various house brands.

century-casinos.name: Century Casinos
century-casinos.description: Century Casinos, Inc. is a gambling company based in Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States. It operates in the gambling industry.

cattolica-assicurazioni.name: Cattolica Assicurazioni
cattolica-assicurazioni.description: Cattolica Assicurazioni was an Italian insurance company that was acquired by Generali Italia in 2022 and merged with Genertel in 2023. It was listed on the FTSE Italia Mid Cap index of the Milan Stock Exchange from 2000 to 2022.

comdirect-bank-aktiengesellschaft.name: comdirect bank Aktiengesellschaft
comdirect-bank-aktiengesellschaft.description: Comdirect Bank Aktiengesellschaft was the third-largest German direct bank based in Quickborn, Schleswig-Holstein. Founded by Commerzbank in 1994, it went public in 2000. The company was integrated back into Commerzbank on November 1, 2020.

castro-model-ltd.name: Castro Model Ltd.
castro-model-ltd.description: Castro is an Israeli clothing company specializing in men's and women's fashions. It is publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and was Israel's largest fashion company in 2013.

century-aluminum.name: Century Aluminum
century-aluminum.description: Century Aluminum Company is a US-based producer of primary aluminum with plants in Kentucky, South Carolina, and Iceland. It is the largest primary aluminum producer in the United States and is headquartered in Chicago.

coinbase.name: Coinbase
coinbase.description: Coinbase Global, Inc. is an American cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2012. It is the largest U.S.-based cryptocurrency exchange and the world's biggest bitcoin custodian, operating in more than 100 countries with over 100 million users.

cirrus-logic.name: Cirrus Logic
cirrus-logic.description: Cirrus Logic Inc. is an American fabless semiconductor supplier specializing in analog, mixed-signal, and audio DSP integrated circuits. Since 1998, its headquarters have been located in Austin, Texas.

cray.name: Cray
cray.description: Cray Inc. is an American supercomputer manufacturer headquartered in Seattle, Washington, and a subsidiary of Hewlett Packard Enterprise. It also produces data storage and analytics systems and holds three of the top four spots in the TOP500 supercomputer rankings as of June 2026.

comptel-corporation.name: Comptel Corporation
comptel-corporation.description: Comptel Corporation was a Finnish international software company specializing in telecommunications. In 2017, Nokia acquired Comptel to integrate it into its Nokia Software business unit.

central-telegraph.name: Central Telegraph
central-telegraph.description: PJSC Central Telegraph is a Russian telecommunications company providing fixed line telephony, internet access, IPTV, communication channel rental, electrical documentation, and integrated business solutions. It operates mainly in Moscow and is wholly owned by Rostelecom.

curevac.name: CureVac
curevac.description: CureVac is a biopharmaceutical company based in Tübingen, Germany, founded in 2000 by Ingmar Hoerr and others. It develops therapies based on messenger RNA (mRNA) and had approximately 375 employees in 2018.

cyberlink.name: CyberLink
cyberlink.description: CyberLink Corp. is a Taiwanese multimedia software company headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan. It produces PC and mobile applications for media playback, video and photo editing, and disc burning and backup solutions. The company operates in the software industry.

codan.name: Codan
codan.description: Codan Limited is a manufacturer and supplier of communications, metal detection, and mining technology headquartered in Adelaide, South Australia. The company operates in the communication technology sector. It is known for its diverse technology products.

cyber-folks.name: Cyber Folks
cyber-folks.description: cyber_Folks S.A. is a Polish capital group headquartered in Poznań, operating in the technology sector. It provides digitalisation solutions such as web hosting, domain registration, SaaS, and communication platforms. The company has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2017.

ctw-inc.name: CTW Inc.
ctw-inc.description: CTW Inc. is a Japanese video game company based in Tokyo. It is mainly known for its browser-based gaming platform, G123.

csg-limited.name: CSG Limited
csg-limited.description: CSG Limited was an Australian business technology company founded in 1988 and publicly listed in 2007. In 2020, it was acquired by Fuji Xerox and integrated into Fujifilm, after which the CSG brand was retired. The company was based in Australia.

ci-games-s-a.name: CI Games S.A.
ci-games-s-a.description: CI Games S.A. is a Polish video game developer and publisher based in Warsaw. Founded in 2002, it is known for the Sniper: Ghost Warrior and Lords of the Fallen series. Originally, it focused on budget-range games.

cube-entertainment.name: Cube Entertainment
cube-entertainment.description: Cube Entertainment, Inc. is a South Korean entertainment company that operates as a record label, talent agency, music production company, event management and concert production company, and music publishing house. It is known for having self-composing and self-producing idols. The founder, Hong Seung-sung, resigned in April 2020 due to an ownership dispute.

croatia-records.name: Croatia Records
croatia-records.description: Croatia Records is a record label located in Zagreb, Croatia. It is owned by AUTOR d.o.o. The company operates in the music industry.

canadian-tire.name: Canadian Tire
canadian-tire.description: Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited is a Canadian retail corporation headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It operates department stores, gas stations, and financial services, and owns several retail brands including Mark's and Sport Chek. It also owns the intellectual property of the former Hudson's Bay Company as of 2025.

china-pacific-insurance.name: China Pacific Insurance
china-pacific-insurance.description: China Pacific Insurance (Group) Co., Ltd., known as Pacific Insurance, is a Chinese insurance company headquartered in Shanghai. It was established based on the former China Pacific Insurance Corporation founded in 1991.

cbre-group.name: CBRE Group
cbre-group.description: CBRE Group, Inc. is an American commercial real estate services and investment firm headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with global financial headquarters in Midtown Manhattan. It is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm by 2025 revenue.

cdw.name: CDW
cdw.description: CDW Corporation is an American provider of information technology services serving business, government, education, and healthcare sectors in the US, UK, and Canada. It is headquartered in Vernon Hills, Illinois.

china-agri-industries-holdings-limited.name: China Agri-Industries Holdings Limited
china-agri-industries-holdings-limited.description: China Agri-Industries Holdings Limited is a leading producer and supplier of processed agricultural products in Mainland China. Its services include biofuel, oilseed processing, rice and wheat processing, and brewing materials.

crobex.name: CROBEX
crobex.description: CROBEX is the official share index of the Zagreb Stock Exchange in Croatia. It includes stocks of 15 companies and is calculated continuously using the latest stock prices. The index is measured using free float market capitalization with a weight limit of 10 percent per stock.

ctt-correios-de-portugal.name: CTT Correios de Portugal
ctt-correios-de-portugal.description: CTT – Correios de Portugal, S.A. is the national postal service of Portugal and a commercial group with subsidiaries in banking, e-commerce, and postal services. Founded in 1520 by King Manuel I, it is the oldest company still operating in Portugal. The company is based in Portugal.

callaway-golf-company.name: Callaway Golf Company
callaway-golf-company.description: Callaway Golf Company is an American global sports equipment manufacturer specializing in golf clubs, balls, and accessories like bags, gloves, and caps. The company designs, manufactures, markets, and sells its products worldwide. It is based in the United States.

cameco.name: Cameco
cameco.description: Cameco Corporation is the world's largest publicly traded uranium company based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada. In 2015, it was the world's second largest uranium producer, accounting for 18% of global production. The company operates in the mining sector.

campbell-s.name: Campbell's
campbell-s.description: The Campbell's Company is an American company best known for its canned soup products. Its classic red-and-white can design has become an American icon and has been featured in American pop art. The company operates in the food industry.

capital-power-corporation.name: Capital Power Corporation
capital-power-corporation.description: Capital Power is a Canadian independent power generation company headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta. It develops, acquires, owns, and operates power generation facilities using various energy sources.

capital-one.name: Capital One
capital-one.description: Capital One Financial Corporation is an American bank holding company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, with operations in the US, Canada, and the UK. It is a major issuer of credit cards and owns Discover Card, Diners Club, and Pulse payment networks.

c3-ai.name: C3.ai
c3-ai.description: C3.ai is an American information technology company specializing in enterprise artificial intelligence. Founded in 2009 by Thomas Siebel, it is based in Redwood City, California. The company became publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange in 2020.

carnival-corporation.name: Carnival Corporation
carnival-corporation.description: Carnival Corporation Ltd. is a Bermuda-domiciled American cruise line operator owning over 90 vessels across eight brands. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and was a dual-listed company with a British counterpart until 2026. The company is a component of the S&P 500 index.

crispr-therapeutics.name: CRISPR Therapeutics
crispr-therapeutics.description: CRISPR Therapeutics AG is a Swiss-American biotechnology company headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with offices in the US and UK. It was among the first to use CRISPR gene editing for medicine development. Its manufacturing facility won the FOYA award in 2022, and its lead program received FDA approval in 2023.

california-water-service-group.name: California Water Service Group
california-water-service-group.description: California Water Service Group (CWSG) is an American public utility company providing drinking water and wastewater services. It serves roughly two million people through subsidiaries in California, Hawaii, New Mexico, and Washington. CWSG was formed in 1997 to expand into other states and businesses.

cenovus-energy.name: Cenovus Energy
cenovus-energy.description: Cenovus Energy Inc. is a Canadian integrated oil and natural gas company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. The company moved its offices to Brookfield Place in 2019 from the neighbouring Bow building.

centerpoint-energy.name: CenterPoint Energy
centerpoint-energy.description: CenterPoint Energy, Inc. is an American utility company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It provides electric and natural gas utility services in Indiana, Ohio, Minnesota, and Texas, and is located in the CenterPoint Energy Tower in Downtown Houston.

cerner.name: Cerner
cerner.description: Oracle Health, formerly Cerner Corporation, is an American multinational provider of health information technology platforms and services. It is headquartered in North Kansas City, Missouri. The company is a leading electronic health record provider with over 9.5 million customers.

changzhou-xingyu-automotive-lighting-sys.name: Changzhou Xingyu Automotive Lighting Systems Co.,Ltd.
changzhou-xingyu-automotive-lighting-sys.legal_name: Changzhou Xingyu Automotive Lighting Systems Co.,Ltd.
changzhou-xingyu-automotive-lighting-sys.description: Changzhou Xingyu Automotive Lighting Systems is a Chinese automotive lighting manufacturer headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province. Established in 1993, it operates 12 factories in China and Serbia and 16 research centers globally, producing lighting systems for major carmakers like Volkswagen and BMW.

listings.name: Changzhou Xingyu Automotive Lighting Systems Co.,Ltd.

charoen-pokphand-foods.name: Charoen Pokphand Foods
charoen-pokphand-foods.description: Charoen Pokphand Foods Public Company Limited is an agro-industrial and food conglomerate headquartered in Thailand. It is one of the world's largest producers of feed and shrimp, and among the top three producers of poultry and pork globally. The company is part of the Charoen Pokphand Group.

cvc-brasil.name: CVC Brasil
cvc-brasil.description: CVC CORP is a Brazilian holding company specializing in tourism. It was founded and is headquartered in Santo André, São Paulo, Brazil.

chevron-lubricants-lanka.name: Chevron Lubricants Lanka
chevron-lubricants-lanka.description: Chevron Lubricants Lanka PLC is a Sri Lankan manufacturer, distributor, and marketer of petroleum-based lubricants. Chevron Corporation holds a controlling 51% stake in the company, which offers products under the Havoline and Delo brands.

china-communications-construction-compan.name: China Communications Construction Company
china-communications-construction-compan.description: China Communications Construction Company, Ltd. is a Chinese majority state-owned multinational engineering and construction company. It focuses on infrastructure projects such as highways, bridges, railways, airports, and marine ports, and has been involved in Belt and Road Initiative projects.

china-coal-energy.name: China Coal Energy
china-coal-energy.description: China Coal Energy Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded Chinese company involved in mining coal and processing coal products. It is listed on both the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

china-international-marine-containers.name: China International Marine Containers
china-international-marine-containers.description: China International Marine Containers (Group) Co., Ltd is a Chinese company that manufactures and sells transportation equipment, including containers, road transport vehicles, and airport ground-handling equipment.

china-overseas-land-and-investment-limit.name: China Overseas Land and Investment Limited
china-overseas-land-and-investment-limit.legal_name: China Overseas Land and Investment Limited
china-overseas-land-and-investment-limit.description: China Overseas Land and Investment Limited (COLI) is a Hong Kong-based real estate conglomerate. It is an indirect subsidiary of China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited.

listings.name: China Overseas Land and Investment Limited

china-resources-beer-holdings-company-li.name: China Resources Beer (Holdings) Company Limited
china-resources-beer-holdings-company-li.description: China Resources Beer is a subsidiary of China Resources Holdings. It owns a 51% share in CR Snow, the largest brewing company in China, which is a joint venture with SAB Miller.

cj-enm-entertainment-division.name: CJ ENM Entertainment Division
cj-enm-entertainment-division.description: CJ ENM Entertainment Division is a South Korean entertainment and mass media division of CJ ENM. It was formerly known as CJ E&M and merged with CJ O Shopping in July 2018, with CJ O Shopping as the surviving entity. The company operates in the media and entertainment industry.

china-everbright-bank.name: China Everbright Bank
china-everbright-bank.description: China Everbright Bank Co., Ltd. is a Chinese joint-stock commercial bank established in August 1992 and headquartered in Beijing. It is approved by the State Council and People's Bank of China and was ranked 139th in the 2016 Forbes Global 2000. It operates in the financial services sector.

china-reinsurance.name: China Reinsurance
china-reinsurance.description: China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation is one of the largest reinsurance groups in China. It operates within the reinsurance industry, providing reinsurance services across the country.

concord-new-energy.name: Concord New Energy
concord-new-energy.description: Concord New Energy Group Limited is a renewable energy company headquartered in Singapore. It develops, owns, and operates wind power, solar energy, and energy storage projects across the Asia-Pacific and North American regions. The company is listed on the Hong Kong and Singapore stock exchanges.

china-everbright-environment.name: China Everbright Environment
china-everbright-environment.description: China Everbright International Limited is a Hong Kong incorporated company specializing in environmental resource management in mainland China.

chubu-electric-power.name: Chubu Electric Power
chubu-electric-power.description: Chubu Electric Power Co., Inc., known as Chuden, is a Japanese electric utilities provider serving the middle Chūbu region of Honshu island. It ranks third among Japan's largest electric utilities by power generation capacity and has expanded into optical fibers and telecommunications.

ciena.name: Ciena
ciena.description: Ciena Corporation is an American optical networking systems and software company based in Hanover, Maryland. It reported revenues of $4.8 billion and employed over 9,000 people as of November 2025. Gary Smith has been CEO since 2003.

central-finance-company.name: Central Finance Company
central-finance-company.description: Central Finance Company PLC is one of Sri Lanka's oldest non-bank financial institutions, founded in 1957. It is listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange since 1969 and was ranked the 28th most valuable brand in Sri Lanka in 2021.

cordiant-digital-infrastructure.name: Cordiant Digital Infrastructure
cordiant-digital-infrastructure.description: Cordiant Digital Infrastructure Limited is a British investment trust focused on infrastructure investments related to the digital economy. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company is based in Guernsey.

coty.name: Coty
coty.description: Coty Inc. is a multinational beauty company founded in Paris in 1904 and incorporated in Delaware, United States. Its global headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Coty develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes a wide range of beauty products and owns around 40 brands as of 2024.

coca-cola-hbc.name: Coca-Cola HBC
coca-cola-hbc.description: Coca-Cola HBC AG is the world's third-largest Coca-Cola anchor bottler by volume. The company is primarily listed on the London Stock Exchange and also on the Athens Stock Exchange. It is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index and is based in Switzerland.

cic-holdings.name: CIC Holdings
cic-holdings.description: CIC Holdings PLC is a Sri Lankan conglomerate engaged in merchandising and manufacturing chemical products. Incorporated and listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange in 1964, it was formerly part of Imperial Chemical Industries and known as Chemical Industries (Colombo) PLC before 2011.

coherent-inc.name: Coherent, Inc.
coherent-inc.description: Coherent, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Santa Clara, California that develops and manufactures laser equipment and specialty components. Founded in 1966, it went public in 1970 and expanded through acquisitions. In 2022, it was acquired by II-VI Incorporated and renamed Coherent Corp.

china-lumena-new-materials-corp.name: China Lumena New Materials Corp.
china-lumena-new-materials-corp.description: China Lumena New Materials is a Chinese mining and manufacturing company specializing in the production of polyphenylene sulfide (PPS), an industrial plastic. It is among the largest producers of PPS according to a 2016 market research report.

cettire.name: Cettire
cettire.description: Cettire is an Australian-owned online luxury fashion retail platform. It sells clothing, shoes, and accessories from over 1300 international high-end fashion brands.

comcast.name: Comcast
comcast.description: Comcast Corporation is an American multinational conglomerate in mass media, telecommunications, and entertainment. Its headquarters are in Philadelphia and New York City, and it is a leading telecommunications and pay-TV company in the US.

cerence-inc.name: Cerence Inc.
cerence-inc.description: Cerence Inc. is an American multinational software company specializing in artificial intelligence assistant technology for automobiles. It operates primarily in the automotive industry sector.

comerica.name: Comerica
comerica.description: Comerica Incorporated was an American financial services company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It was the parent company of Comerica Bank, a regional commercial bank with branches in Texas, Michigan, California, Florida, and Arizona. Comerica was one of the largest U.S. financial holding companies before being acquired by Fifth Third Bank in 2026.

comgas.name: Comgás
comgas.description: Companhia de Gás de São Paulo - Comgás is a Brazilian gas distributor focused on São Paulo state. It is Brazil's largest gas distributor, operating about 14,000 kilometers of pipelines supplying over 1.7 million consumers in 88 cities. Comgás sells gas under a 30-year franchise with potential extension.

companhia-energetica-de-sao-paulo.name: Companhia Energética de São Paulo
companhia-energetica-de-sao-paulo.description: Companhia Energética de São Paulo (CESP) is the largest electricity producer in São Paulo state and the third largest in Brazil. It owns and operates six hydroelectric plants connected to the National Interconnected System. The company is based in Brazil.

companhia-energetica-de-minas-gerais.name: Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais
companhia-energetica-de-minas-gerais.description: Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais S.A. is a Brazilian power company headquartered in Belo Horizonte. It operates in generation, transmission, distribution, and commercialization of electric energy, as well as natural gas distribution. It is one of the main electricity concessionaires in Brazil.

cpfl-energia.name: CPFL Energia
cpfl-energia.description: CPFL Energia is the second largest non-state-owned electric energy generation and distribution group in Brazil. Headquartered in Campinas, São Paulo, it comprises several holding companies and was acquired by the State Grid Corporation of China in 2017.

computer-sciences-corporation.name: Computer Sciences Corporation
computer-sciences-corporation.description: Computer Sciences Corporation (CSC) was an American multinational IT and professional services company founded in Los Angeles in 1959. It became the largest software company in the US within four years and was the largest non-manufacturing IT services provider worldwide by 2009.

conagra-brands-inc.name: Conagra Brands, Inc.
conagra-brands-inc.description: Conagra Brands, Inc. is an American consumer packaged goods holding company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It produces and sells products under various brand names available in supermarkets, restaurants, and food service establishments. The company was founded in Nebraska in 1919 and was originally called Nebraska Consolidated Mills.

concha-y-toro.name: Concha y Toro
concha-y-toro.description: Concha y Toro is the largest producer and exporter of wines from Latin America and one of the ten largest wine companies globally. The winery is located in Santiago de Chile and has vineyards in Chile, Argentina, and the United States. It is known for internationally recognized wines such as Casillero del Diablo and Don Melchor.

constellation-brands.name: Constellation Brands
constellation-brands.description: Constellation Brands, Inc. is an American producer and marketer of beer, wine, and spirits headquartered in Rochester, New York. It is the largest beer import company in the US by sales and holds the third-largest market share among major beer suppliers. The company also has investments in medical and recreational cannabis through Canopy Growth.

convergys.name: Convergys
convergys.description: Convergys Corporation was a Cincinnati, Ohio-based company that sold customer management and information management products to large corporations. Its products served various markets including communications, financial services, technology, retail, healthcare, and government. It employed approximately 130,000 people across 33 countries.

cooper-tire-rubber-company.name: Cooper Tire & Rubber Company
cooper-tire-rubber-company.description: Cooper Tire & Rubber Company is an American company headquartered in Findlay, Ohio, specializing in the design, manufacture, marketing, and sales of replacement automobile and truck tires. It has subsidiaries focusing on medium truck, motorcycle, and racing tires and operates 60 facilities worldwide.

cyberagent.name: CyberAgent
cyberagent.description: CyberAgent Inc. is a Japanese entertainment conglomerate founded in 1998 by Susumu Fujita and headquartered in Shibuya, Tokyo. Fujita owns 20.50% of the company and serves as its representative director, with Yusuke Hidaka as executive vice president.

companhia-paranaense-de-energia.name: Companhia Paranaense de Energia
companhia-paranaense-de-energia.description: Companhia Paranaense de Energia (COPEL) is a Brazilian electric utility company and the largest in the State of Paraná. Founded in 1954, its ownership control is held by the State of Paraná.

copperbelt-energy-corporation.name: Copperbelt Energy Corporation
copperbelt-energy-corporation.description: Copperbelt Energy Corporation Plc is a Zambian company involved in electricity generation, transmission, distribution, and supply. It operates in Zambia and Nigeria and is listed on the Lusaka Stock Exchange. The company is based in Zambia.

corecivic.name: CoreCivic
corecivic.description: CoreCivic, Inc. is an American private prison operator and one of the largest for-profit prison, jail, and detention contractors in the United States. It operates 82 state and federal correctional and detention facilities and has been subject to investigations and lawsuits related to civil rights violations.

crnogorski-telekom.name: Crnogorski Telekom
crnogorski-telekom.description: Crnogorski Telekom is a Montenegrin telecommunications operator based in Podgorica. It is the largest telecommunications company in Montenegro, providing fixed-line, mobile, IPTV, internet, ICT, and cloud services.

capman.name: Capman
capman.description: CapMan Oyj is a Finnish private equity fund manager founded in 1989 and headquartered in Helsinki. It manages funds mainly from European institutional investors and focuses on Private Equity, Real Estate, and Infrastructure investments, employing professionals across several European cities.

componenta.name: Componenta
componenta.description: Componenta is a Finnish contract manufacturer of cast and machined metal components. Its customers are global manufacturers of vehicles, machines, and equipment. The company is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki.

cj-enm-commerce-division.name: CJ ENM Commerce Division
cj-enm-commerce-division.description: CJ ENM Commerce Division is a commerce division of CJ Group based in South Korea. It operates within the media and entertainment industry. The division is part of the larger CJ Group conglomerate.

chong-kun-dang.name: Chong Kun Dang
chong-kun-dang.description: Chong Kun Dang is a South Korean multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1941 as Goongbon Pharmacy and renamed in 1946, it has become one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in South Korea.

coupang.name: Coupang
coupang.description: Coupang, Inc. is an American online retail and technology company headquartered in Seattle, Washington, operating primarily in South Korea and Taiwan. Founded in South Korea in 2010, it operates an internet retail business, food delivery service, and OTT streaming service with offices in multiple countries.

caesarstone-sdot-yam.name: Caesarstone Sdot-Yam
caesarstone-sdot-yam.description: Caesarstone Ltd. is a publicly traded company headquartered in Kibbutz Sdot Yam, Israel, producing engineered stone surfaces for kitchen countertops, flooring, and interior design. Founded in 1987, it has production facilities in Israel and India and sources products from China, selling in about 50 countries through subsidiaries and distributors.

chicken-soup-for-the-soul-entertainment.name: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment
chicken-soup-for-the-soul-entertainment.legal_name: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment
chicken-soup-for-the-soul-entertainment.description: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment, Inc. was an American media company based in Cos Cob, Connecticut. Established in 2016, it was a subsidiary of the publisher Chicken Soup for the Soul.

listings.name: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment

craft-brew-alliance.name: Craft Brew Alliance
craft-brew-alliance.description: Craft Brew Alliance, Inc. was a beer brewing company composed of five beer and cider brands including Redhook Ale Brewery and Kona Brewing Company. It operated in the United States.

coherent-corp.name: Coherent Corp.
coherent-corp.description: Coherent Corp. is an American manufacturer of optical materials and semiconductors. In 2022, II-VI acquired laser manufacturer Coherent, Inc. and adopted its name. The company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker COHR.

calliduscloud.name: CallidusCloud
calliduscloud.description: Callidus Software Inc., formerly CallidusCloud, is an enterprise software and SaaS company headquartered in Dublin, California. It markets software and services for sales effectiveness, management, and execution, and is part of the SAP Sales Cloud.

corcept-therapeutics.name: Corcept Therapeutics
corcept-therapeutics.description: Corcept Therapeutics Inc. is a pharmaceutical company focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing drugs for severe metabolic, psychiatric, and oncologic disorders. It studies compounds that may mitigate the adverse effects of excess cortisol. The company is led by CEO Joseph K. Belanoff, MD.

china-zheshang-bank.name: China Zheshang Bank
china-zheshang-bank.description: China Zheshang Bank is a national joint-stock commercial bank based in China. It is regulated by the People's Bank of China.

china-cinda-asset-management-co-ltd.name: China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd.
china-cinda-asset-management-co-ltd.legal_name: China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd.
china-cinda-asset-management-co-ltd.description: China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd., known as Cinda, is a Chinese distressed asset management company headquartered in Beijing.

listings.name: China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd.

china-galaxy-securities.name: China Galaxy Securities
china-galaxy-securities.description: China Galaxy Securities Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned brokerage and investment bank. It operates within the financial services sector in China.

cepheid.name: Cepheid
cepheid.description: Cepheid is an American molecular diagnostics company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It is a subsidiary of Danaher Corporation and produces automated nucleic acid test systems used to identify pathogens and genetic disorders, selling clinical tests for various health conditions.

cofix-group-ltd.name: Cofix Group Ltd
cofix-group-ltd.description: Cofix is an Israeli coffee shop, bar, and supermarket chain established in 2013 by Avi Katz. It uses a fixed price menu system and has branches mostly in city centers and near educational institutions such as Haifa University.

cineverse.name: Cineverse
cineverse.description: Cineverse Corp. is an American entertainment company headquartered in Los Angeles, California. Its business activities include digital cinema, streaming channels, content marketing, and distribution. The company operates within the entertainment industry.

city-developments-limited.name: City Developments Limited
city-developments-limited.description: City Developments Limited (CDL) is a Singaporean multinational real estate company founded in 1963. It initially developed projects in Johor Bahru and Singapore but later consolidated into Singapore. CDL is controlled by Hong Leong Bank since 1969 and develops various property types.

china-aerospace-international-holdings-l.name: China Aerospace International Holdings Limited
china-aerospace-international-holdings-l.description: China Aerospace International Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong incorporated holding company and a subsidiary of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation. It is listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong as a red chip company.

corpay.name: Corpay
corpay.description: Corpay, Inc. is a financial services company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It provides payments and spend management systems focusing on vehicle-related expenses, lodging expenses, and corporate payments. The company controls expense-related purchasing and payment processes.

ceres-inc.name: Ceres, Inc.
ceres-inc.description: Ceres, Inc. was a biotechnology company based in Thousand Oaks, California, operating from 1996 to 2016. It developed genetically modified crop seeds for biofuel production and had a subsidiary in Brazil. The company was acquired by Land O'Lakes in 2016.

ceylon-tobacco-company.name: Ceylon Tobacco Company
ceylon-tobacco-company.description: Ceylon Tobacco Company PLC is a Sri Lankan tobacco manufacturer and marketer. It holds a monopoly on cigarette and tobacco sales in Sri Lanka and is a subsidiary of British American Tobacco. The company has been listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange since the 1980s.

community-west-bancshares.name: Community West Bancshares
community-west-bancshares.description: Community West Bancshares is a registered bank holding company headquartered in California. It wholly owns Community West Bank and operates under the Bank Holding Company Act.

copart.name: Copart
copart.description: Copart, Inc. is a multinational company headquartered in Dallas, Texas, providing online vehicle auction and remarketing services. It serves automotive resellers in 11 countries and operates more than 200 physical locations with over 10,000 acres of vehicle inventory. Copart uses patented virtual auction technology to facilitate vehicle sales.

cyrusone.name: CyrusOne
cyrusone.description: CyrusOne, Inc. owns and operates over 40 carrier-neutral data centers across North America, Europe, and Asia. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, it provides colocation and peering services and is owned by funds managed by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts and Global Infrastructure Partners.

cerillion.name: Cerillion
cerillion.description: Cerillion plc is a UK-based telecommunications software company providing business support systems and operations support systems to communications service providers. Founded in 1999, it supports billing, charging, customer relationship management, and digital service monetisation for various operators and is listed on the AIM market of the London Stock Exchange.

china-machinery-engineering-corporation.name: China Machinery Engineering Corporation
china-machinery-engineering-corporation.description: China Machinery Engineering Corporation (CMEC) is a construction and engineering company based in China. It is part of the China National Machinery Industry Corporation (Sinomach) group. CMEC specializes in constructing power projects including generation, transmission, and distribution.

clarcor.name: Clarcor
clarcor.description: CLARCOR Inc. was a manufacturer of filtration systems and packaging materials based in Franklin, Tennessee. Founded in 1904 in Rockford, Illinois, it operated approximately 30 manufacturing and distribution sites in the United States.

castlight-health.name: Castlight Health
castlight-health.description: Castlight Health is a healthcare navigation company based in Sandy, Utah. It provides comparison tools that show price and quality metrics for healthcare tests and procedures.

california-first-national-bancorp.name: California First National Bancorp
california-first-national-bancorp.description: California First National Bancorp is a financial holding company headquartered in California. It operates an FDIC-insured national bank and a leasing company specializing in financing high-technology capital assets, offering various leasing, financing, deposit, and commercial loan services.

clean-diesel-technologies.name: Clean Diesel Technologies
clean-diesel-technologies.description: CDTI Advanced Materials, Inc. is an American company specializing in vehicle emissions control systems for diesel engines. It has two divisions focused on exhaust emission devices and catalysts, with patented technologies and EPA-verified products widely used in highway vehicles.

cloud-peak-energy.name: Cloud Peak Energy
cloud-peak-energy.description: Cloud Peak Energy Inc. is a coal mining company headquartered in Gillette, Wyoming. It was formed in 2009 as a spin-off from Rio Tinto Energy America and holds a 50% stake in the Decker Coal Company operating in Montana.

coca-cola-icecek.name: Coca-Cola İçecek
coca-cola-icecek.description: Coca-Cola İçecek A.Ş. is a major bottler in the Coca-Cola System based in Istanbul, Turkey. It is partly owned by Anadolu Efes and The Coca-Cola Company and is the fifth largest bottler by sales volume within the system.

costar-group.name: CoStar Group
costar-group.description: CoStar Group, Inc. is an American company providing information, analytics, and marketing services for the commercial property industry in North America and Europe. Founded in 1987, it is based in Arlington, Virginia and operates several online marketplaces including Apartments.com.

chun-nan-jun.name: Chun Nan Jun
chun-nan-jun.description: Chun Nan Jun, also known as Ziyang Nanjun Automobile Co., Ltd, is a Chinese truck manufacturer based in Yanjiang, Ziyang, Sichuan. The company produces heavy, medium, and light duty trucks, mini trucks, and buses. It ranks 19th in China's auto industry and second in the commercial vehicle sector.

cf-moto.name: CF MOTO
cf-moto.description: CFMOTO, officially Zhejiang Chunfeng Power Co., Ltd., is a Chinese manufacturer based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang. It produces engines, motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles, quadricycles, quads, and yachts. The company is commonly known by its trade name CFMOTO.

cargurus.name: CarGurus
cargurus.description: CarGurus, Inc. is a Boston-based automotive research and shopping website operating in the U.S., U.K., and Canada. It helps consumers and auto dealers compare local listings for used and new cars and provides tools for researching and financing vehicle purchases.

c-mer-industries-ltd.name: C. Mer Industries Ltd.
c-mer-industries-ltd.description: Mer Group Ltd. is an Israeli holding company consisting of three autonomous business divisions. Each division is led by a company with subsidiaries, manufacturing facilities, and logistics chains. It operates primarily in Israel.

carecloud.name: CareCloud
carecloud.description: CareCloud, Inc. is an American healthcare information technology company providing services to healthcare providers and hospitals. It is publicly traded and headquartered in Somerset, New Jersey, employing approximately 4,000 workers worldwide.

civeo-corporation.name: Civeo Corporation
civeo-corporation.description: The Civeo Corporation is an American multinational company providing accommodation services. It is a spin-off of Oil States International and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

cummins.name: Cummins
cummins.description: Cummins Inc. is an American multinational corporation that designs, manufactures, and distributes diesel engines, electric vehicle components, and power generation products. It also services engines and related equipment. The company is based in the United States.

clearwater-analytics.name: Clearwater Analytics
clearwater-analytics.description: Clearwater Analytics Holdings, Inc. is a US-based fintech company providing automated investment accounting, performance, compliance, and risk reporting via software-as-a-service. It is headquartered in Boise, Idaho, with offices in London, Edinburgh, New York City, and Noida.

computershare.name: Computershare
computershare.description: Computershare Limited is an Australian stock transfer company providing corporate trust, stock transfer, and employee share plan services internationally.

cae-inc.name: CAE Inc.
cae-inc.description: CAE Inc. is a Canadian manufacturer of simulation and modelling technologies and training services for airlines, aircraft manufacturers, and defense customers. Founded in 1947, it has manufacturing operations and training facilities in 35 countries worldwide.

catalyst-pharmaceuticals.name: Catalyst Pharmaceuticals
catalyst-pharmaceuticals.description: Catalyst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in Coral Gables, Florida. It develops medicines for rare diseases, including Firdapse, a drug approved by the FDA for treating Lambert–Eaton myasthenic syndrome in adults and children.

cimic-group.name: CIMIC Group
cimic-group.description: CIMIC Group Limited is an engineering-led company specializing in construction, mining, services, and public private partnerships. It works across the lifecycle of assets, infrastructure, and resources projects.

canopy-growth-corporation.name: Canopy Growth Corporation
canopy-growth-corporation.description: Canopy Growth Corporation is a Canadian cannabis company based in Smiths Falls, Ontario. It was formerly known as Tweed Marijuana Inc.

caesars-entertainment.name: Caesars Entertainment
caesars-entertainment.description: Caesars Entertainment, formerly Eldorado Resorts, is an American hotel and casino entertainment company based in Reno, Nevada. It operates more than 50 properties and adopted its current name after acquiring Caesars Entertainment Corporation in 2020.

ck-hutchison-holdings.name: CK Hutchison Holdings
ck-hutchison-holdings.description: CK Hutchison Holdings Limited is a multinational conglomerate based in Hong Kong and registered in the Cayman Islands. Formed in 2015 by merging Cheung Kong Holdings and Hutchison Whampoa, it operates four core businesses: ports, retail, infrastructure, and telecommunications across over 50 countries.

concordia-healthcare-corp.name: Concordia Healthcare Corp
concordia-healthcare-corp.description: Advanz Pharma Corp., formerly Concordia Healthcare Corp., is a British multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in London. It focuses on various therapy areas and acquiring off-patent pharmaceutical compounds, with operational centers in London, Mumbai, and regional hubs in Europe, Australia, and Canada.

catalent-pharma-solutions.name: Catalent Pharma Solutions
catalent-pharma-solutions.description: Catalent, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Tampa, Florida. It provides drug delivery technologies, development, manufacturing, biologics, gene therapy, and consumer health products, operating over 50 facilities on four continents.

clearsign-combustion.name: ClearSign Combustion
clearsign-combustion.description: ClearSign Technologies Corporation is a United States-based company that develops emission-control technology.

ck-asset-holdings.name: CK Asset Holdings
ck-asset-holdings.description: CK Asset Holdings Limited is a property developer registered in the Cayman Islands with headquarters in Hong Kong. It was formerly known as Cheung Kong Property Holdings Limited.

city-union-bank.name: City Union Bank
city-union-bank.description: City Union Bank Limited is an Indian private sector bank headquartered in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu. Originally named Kumbakonam Bank Limited, it was incorporated on 31 October 1904 and initially operated as a regional bank in Kumbakonam.

chemours.name: Chemours
chemours.description: The Chemours Company is an American chemical company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. Spun off from DuPont in 2015, it produces refrigerants, titanium dioxide pigment, and industrial fluoropolymer resins, operating 28 major production facilities in 8 countries.

complete-genomics.name: Complete Genomics
complete-genomics.description: Complete Genomics is a life sciences company based in the United States that has developed and commercialized a DNA sequencing platform for human genome sequencing and analysis.

caffyns.name: Caffyns
caffyns.description: Caffyns plc is a United Kingdom-based motor retailer with dealerships in Ashford, Brighton, Eastbourne, Lewes, Tunbridge Wells, and Worthing. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker CFYN in the general retailers sector.

china-energy-engineering.name: China Energy Engineering
china-energy-engineering.description: China Energy Engineering Corporation, also known as Energy China, is a Chinese state-owned energy conglomerate headquartered in Chaoyang District, Beijing.

cornerstone-ondemand-inc.name: Cornerstone OnDemand Inc.
cornerstone-ondemand-inc.description: Cornerstone OnDemand, Inc. is a cloud-based human capital management software company headquartered in Santa Monica, California. Founded in 1999 as CyberU, it provides learning management and talent management platforms. The company was taken private in 2021 by Clearlake Capital.

citic-financial-amc.name: CITIC Financial AMC
citic-financial-amc.description: China CITIC Financial Asset Management is a majority state-owned financial asset management company in China focused on distressed debt management. It was one of four asset management companies established by the Chinese government in 1999 following the 1997 Asian financial crisis.

clover-health.name: Clover Health
clover-health.description: Clover Health Investments, Corp. is an American health care company founded in 2014. It provides Medicare Advantage insurance plans and operates as a direct contracting entity with the U.S. government. The company manages care for Medicare beneficiaries in 11 states.

cimpress.name: Cimpress
cimpress.description: Cimpress plc is an Irish multinational technology company that operates various businesses using mass customization to produce small quantities of customized goods. Its products are sold to small businesses, graphic designers, and consumers through multiple customer-facing brands.

clovis-oncology.name: Clovis Oncology
clovis-oncology.description: Clovis Oncology is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, specializing in oncology treatments. Founded in 2009, it filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in December 2022.

cave.name: CAVE
cave.description: CAVE Interactive Co., Ltd. is a Japanese video game company founded in 1994 by former Toaplan employees. It is known for its "bullet hell" shoot 'em ups and has produced various games for arcades, consoles, PCs, and smartphones.

cosmo-oil-company.name: Cosmo Oil Company
cosmo-oil-company.description: Cosmo Oil Company, Limited is a Japanese petrochemical company and the third-biggest refiner in Japan by sales. It operates in the petroleum industry and is based in Japan.

colfax-corporation.name: Colfax Corporation
colfax-corporation.description: Enovis Corporation, originally founded as Colfax Corporation in 1995 by Mitchell and Steven Rales, is a medical technology company focused on orthopedics. It is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, and operates at 30 sites worldwide.

constellation-energy.name: Constellation Energy
constellation-energy.description: Constellation Energy Corporation is an American energy company headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland. It supplies electric power, natural gas, and energy management services to about two million customers across the continental United States.

csc-financial-co-ltd.name: CSC Financial Co., Ltd.
csc-financial-co-ltd.description: CSC Financial Co., Ltd., trading as China Securities, is a Chinese investment bank and brokerage firm established in 2005 by CITIC Securities and China Jianyin Investment. It is majority owned by Central Huijin Investment and a Beijing municipal asset managing subsidiary.

cheniere-energy.name: Cheniere Energy
cheniere-energy.description: Cheniere Energy, Inc. is an American liquefied natural gas (LNG) company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It operates in the oil and gas industry, focusing on LNG production and related activities.

chewy.name: Chewy
chewy.description: Chewy, Inc. is an American online retailer specializing in pet food and pet-related products. The company is based in Plantation, Florida, and went public in 2019. It operates primarily through e-commerce channels.

criteo.name: Criteo
criteo.description: Criteo S.A. is an advertising technology company headquartered in Paris, France. Initially focused on online display retargeting, it has expanded into retail media advertising since the mid-2010s.

costa-group.name: Costa Group
costa-group.description: Costa Group is Australia's largest horticultural company and a major supplier of produce to food retailers. The company went public in 2015 and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

china-southern-airlines.name: China Southern Airlines
china-southern-airlines.description: China Southern Airlines is a major airline headquartered in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. It is one of the three major airlines in the country alongside Air China and China Eastern Airlines. The company operates in the transportation sector within the airline industry.

china-eastern-airlines.name: China Eastern Airlines
china-eastern-airlines.description: China Eastern Airlines is a major airline headquartered in Minhang, Shanghai, China. It is one of the three largest airlines in the country alongside Air China and China Southern Airlines.

cap-s-a.name: CAP S.A.
cap-s-a.description: CAP S.A., also known as the Pacific Steel Company, is a Chilean holding company in the mining and steel sectors. Its main facilities are located at Huachipato near the port of Talcahuano in the Bío Bío Region.

cameron-international.name: Cameron International
cameron-international.description: Cameron International Corporation was a global provider of pressure control and flow control systems for the oil and gas and process industries. The company was acquired by SLB in 2016 and now operates as a legacy brand.

carmike-cinemas.name: Carmike Cinemas
carmike-cinemas.description: Carmike Cinemas, Inc. was an American motion picture exhibitor headquartered in Columbus, Georgia. It operated 276 theaters with 2,954 screens across 41 states and was the fourth largest movie theater chain in the U.S. before ceasing operations.

casey-s-general-stores.name: Casey's General Stores
casey-s-general-stores.description: Casey's General Stores, Inc. is a chain of convenience stores operating in the Midwestern and Southern United States. It is the third-largest chain in the country by number of locations and the largest American-owned chain, with many stores in small towns.

cellectis.name: Cellectis
cellectis.description: Cellectis is a French biopharmaceutical company that develops genome-edited chimeric antigen receptor T-cell technologies for cancer immunotherapy. It has offices in Paris, New York City, and Raleigh, North Carolina.

charter-communications.name: Charter Communications
charter-communications.description: Charter Communications, Inc. is an American telecommunications and mass media company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, with services branded as Spectrum.

cineplex-entertainment.name: Cineplex Entertainment
cineplex-entertainment.description: Cineplex Inc. is a Canadian entertainment and media company headquartered in Toronto. It operates movie theatres and family entertainment centres and is the largest cinema chain in Canada. As of 2019, it operated 165 locations and accounted for 75% of the domestic box office.

cloudera.name: Cloudera
cloudera.description: Cloudera, Inc. is an American company specializing in data lake software. It operates in the data analytics software industry.

cognex-corporation.name: Cognex Corporation
cognex-corporation.description: Cognex Corporation is an American manufacturer headquartered in Natick, Massachusetts. It produces machine vision systems, software, and sensors used in automated manufacturing for inspection, defect detection, product assembly verification, and robot guidance. The company has offices in more than 20 countries.

colas-group.name: Colas Group
colas-group.description: Colas Group is a major French civil engineering firm specializing in road and rail track construction through its Colas Rail subsidiary. Since the 1990s, it has incorporated the Screg and Sacer road construction firms.

colbun-s-a.name: Colbun S.A.
colbun-s-a.description: Colbún is a Chilean utility company engaged in electric power transmission. Founded in 1982 and privatized in 1997, it operates hydroelectric and fossil fuel plants and supplies the Sistema Interconectado Central power grid. It is developing the HidroAysén hydroelectric project in the Aisén Region.

ccu.name: CCU
ccu.description: Compañía Cervecerías Unidas S.A. (CCU) is a Chilean producer of diversified beverages founded in 1902. It produces alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages and operates in the food sector across several South American countries. The company has operations in Chile, Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia, Paraguay, Uruguay, and Peru.

cosan.name: Cosan
cosan.description: Cosan S.A. is a Brazilian conglomerate producing bioethanol, sugar, and energy. It operates in Brazil and several South American countries and also in the United Kingdom under the Moove brand, manufacturing and supplying lubricants and related products.

croda-international.name: Croda International
croda-international.description: Croda International plc is a British speciality chemicals company based in Snaith, England. It operates in the chemical industry and is listed on the London Stock Exchange. The company focuses on producing speciality chemicals.

cyberstep-holdings.name: CyberStep Holdings
cyberstep-holdings.description: CyberStep, Inc. is a Japanese global online video game developer and publisher founded on April 1, 2000. The company operates in the video game industry and is based in Japan.

cytokinetics.name: Cytokinetics
cytokinetics.description: Cytokinetics, Incorporated is a biopharmaceutical company based in South San Francisco, California. It develops muscle activators and inhibitors as potential treatments for diseases involving impaired or declining muscle function.

cathay-pacific.name: Cathay Pacific
cathay-pacific.description: Cathay Pacific Airways Limited is the flag carrier airline of Hong Kong. Its head office and main hub are located at Hong Kong International Airport. The airline operates passenger and cargo services to over 190 destinations in more than 60 countries worldwide.

celcomdigi.name: CelcomDigi
celcomdigi.description: CelcomDigi Berhad is a communications conglomerate and mobile service provider based in Malaysia. It is jointly owned by Axiata and Telenor, each holding 33.1%. CelcomDigi is the largest wireless carrier in Malaysia.

coast-entertainment.name: Coast Entertainment
coast-entertainment.description: Coast Entertainment Holdings Limited is an Australian leisure company operating Dreamworld, the largest theme park in Australia, WhiteWater World water park, and the SkyPoint Observation Deck on the Gold Coast, Queensland.
