ceat.name: CEAT
ceat.description: CEAT Limited is an Indian multinational tyre manufacturing company owned by the RPG Group. Founded in 1924 in Turin, Italy, and acquired by RPG Group in 1982, CEAT produces tyres for various vehicles and operates multiple manufacturing plants across India.

credito-emiliano.name: Credito Emiliano
credito-emiliano.description: Credito Emiliano S.p.A. (Credem) is an Italian bank based in Reggio Emilia, Emilia-Romagna. Founded in 1910, its shares have been listed on Borsa Italiana since 1997, and it is part of the FTSE Italia Mid Cap index.

credit-suisse.name: Credit Suisse
credit-suisse.description: Credit Suisse Group AG was a Swiss investment bank and financial services firm headquartered in Zürich, Switzerland. It provided services in investment banking, private banking, asset management, and shared services. The bank was known for strict client confidentiality and was considered globally systemically important.

centerra-gold.name: Centerra Gold
centerra-gold.description: Centerra Gold Inc. is a Canadian mining company headquartered in Toronto. It owns and operates mines including the Mount Milligan copper-gold mine in British Columbia and the Öksüt gold mine in Turkey. The company also owns inactive molybdenum mines through its subsidiary Thompson Creek Metals.

china-citic-bank.name: China CITIC Bank
china-citic-bank.description: China CITIC Bank is a major commercial bank in China operating under the CITIC Group. It provides banking services within the Chinese financial sector.

companhia-siderurgica-nacional.name: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional
companhia-siderurgica-nacional.description: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (CSN) is the largest fully integrated steel producer in Brazil and one of the largest in Latin America. Its main plant is located in Volta Redonda, Rio de Janeiro, and it is a major player in crude steel production.

cri-middleware.name: CRI Middleware
cri-middleware.description: CRI Middleware Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company that develops middleware for the video game industry. Originally a video game developer from the early 1990s, it shifted its focus to middleware development in 2001. The company supports game development through its software products.

coterra-energy.name: Coterra Energy
coterra-energy.description: Coterra Energy Inc. was an American hydrocarbon exploration company with operations in the Permian Basin, Marcellus Shale, and Anadarko Basin. In May 2026, it merged with Devon Energy and the Coterra name was retired. It was ranked 496th in the Fortune 500 before the merger.

changhong.name: Changhong
changhong.description: Sichuan Changhong Electric Co., Ltd., known as Changhong domestically and CHiQ internationally, is a Chinese consumer electronics company based in Mianyang, Sichuan. Founded in 1958, it was the second-largest television manufacturer in China as of 2010 and exported 90% of TVs from China to the US in 2004.

china-everbright-limited.name: China Everbright Limited
china-everbright-limited.description: China Everbright Limited is a Hong Kong-based financial services company involved in asset management, investment, and merchant banking in Greater China. It is part of the China Everbright Group, a state-owned enterprise supervised by the State Council of China.

china-properties-group.name: China Properties Group
china-properties-group.description: China Properties Group Limited is a private property developer based in the Cayman Islands. It focuses on large-scale residential and commercial projects in major Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Beijing, and Kunshan. The company's chairman is Wang Shizhong.

chloride-group.name: Chloride Group
chloride-group.description: Chloride Group is a UK-based global company specializing in the design, production, and maintenance of industrial uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems. It ensures reliable power for critical equipment across industries. The company was formerly listed on the London Stock Exchange and became privately owned in 2021.

caleres.name: Caleres
caleres.description: Caleres Inc. is an American footwear company owning and operating various footwear brands. Its headquarters is in Clayton, Missouri, near St. Louis. The company was founded in 1878 as Bryan, Brown & Company and has undergone several name changes.

chelyabinsk-pipe-rolling-plant-group.name: Chelyabinsk Pipe Rolling Plant Group
chelyabinsk-pipe-rolling-plant-group.description: Chelyabinsk Tube Rolling Plant manufactures various types of steel pipes used in petroleum, natural gas, water pipelines, and manufacturing processes. The company is based in Russia.

cathay-bank.name: Cathay Bank
cathay-bank.description: Cathay Bank is a Chinese American bank founded in 1962 in the United States. It serves the financial sector primarily focusing on banking services for the Chinese American community.

changjiang-securities.name: Changjiang Securities
changjiang-securities.description: Changjiang Securities Company Limited is a securities firm headquartered in Wuhan, Hubei, China. It offers a wide range of securities services including sales, underwriting, and investment consulting. The company operates numerous branches and departments nationwide.

citic-guoan.name: CITIC Guoan
citic-guoan.description: CITIC Guoan Information Industry Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company in computer network infrastructure and information services. Founded in 1997 by CITIC Guoan Group, it operates cable and satellite networks and provides software development and telecom services. It is publicly traded on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.

credit-bank-of-moscow.name: Credit Bank of Moscow
credit-bank-of-moscow.description: Credit Bank of Moscow is a Russian bank established in 1992. It operates primarily in Moscow and the surrounding Moscow Oblast region. The bank provides financial services within Russia.

china-foods-limited.name: China Foods Limited
china-foods-limited.description: China Foods Limited is a Hong Kong Stock Exchange-listed company engaged in food processing and trading. Its products include oilseed, wineries, beverages, confectionery, wheat, brewing materials, rice, biofuel, biochemicals, and edible oil. The company underwent leadership changes in 2019.

ctc-media.name: CTC Media
ctc-media.description: CTC Media LLC is a Russian broadcasting company headquartered in Moscow. It operates in the communication sector providing media services.

chunlan-group.name: Chunlan Group
chunlan-group.description: Chunlan Group Corp is a Chinese corporation headquartered in Taizhou, Jiangsu province. It operates in the electronics industry. The company is notable for being based in one of China's key industrial regions.

cracker-barrel.name: Cracker Barrel
cracker-barrel.description: CBOCS Properties, Inc., doing business as Cracker Barrel, is an American chain of restaurants and gift stores with a Southern country theme. Founded in 1969 in Lebanon, Tennessee, the company expanded from locations near Interstate Highway exits to operate 660 stores in 44 states as of 2023.

cherkizovo.name: Cherkizovo
cherkizovo.description: Cherkizovo is a Moscow-based Russian food company that is a major producer and processor of poultry and pork. It operates in the food industry within Russia. The company is notable for its significant role in meat production and processing.

cmc-magnetics.name: CMC Magnetics
cmc-magnetics.description: CMC Magnetics Corporation is a Taiwanese manufacturer of optical discs with factories in Taiwan and Hong Kong. In 2015, it acquired the optical disc brand and intellectual property from Taiyo Yuden, ending Taiyo Yuden's own production in Japan.

creative-technology.name: Creative Technology
creative-technology.description: Creative Technology Ltd., also known as Creative Labs Pte Ltd., is a Singaporean multinational electronics company specializing in audio technologies and products such as speakers, headphones, and sound cards. Founded by Sim Wong Hoo, it was influential in advancing PC audio in the 1990s with its Sound Blaster card.

cj-group.name: CJ Group
cj-group.description: CJ Corporation, known as CJ Group, is a South Korean conglomerate headquartered in Seoul. It operates internationally across various industries including food, bio, logistics, retail, entertainment, and media. It originated from Cheil Jedang, Samsung's first manufacturing business founded in 1953.

cadence-bank.name: Cadence Bank
cadence-bank.description: Cadence Bank was a commercial bank with dual headquarters in Tupelo, Mississippi, and Houston, Texas. It operated in multiple states including Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, and Illinois.

compass-re.name: Compass RE
compass-re.description: Compass, Inc. is a residential real estate brokerage company operating in the United States. It has approximately 340,000 agents and associates, mostly independent contractors, and operates under multiple brand names including Compass, Century 21, and Sotheby's International Realty.

chow-tai-fook-jewellery-group.name: Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group
chow-tai-fook-jewellery-group.description: Chow Tai Fook group is a Hong Kong–based, privately owned conglomerate with holdings in jewellery, property development, hotels, and other sectors. It is partially listed on the stock market via associate company New World Development and subsidiary Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited.

chenming-paper.name: Chenming Paper
chenming-paper.description: Shandong Chenming Paper Holdings Limited, known as Chenming Paper, is a Chinese company engaged in paper pulp manufacturing, papermaking, and power generation. Based in Shouguang, Shandong, it is the largest papermaking enterprise in China and among the top 50 paper producers worldwide. It operates eight paper mills across China.

cbl-properties.name: CBL Properties
cbl-properties.description: CBL & Associates Properties, Inc. is a real estate investment trust headquartered in Chattanooga, Tennessee. It invests primarily in shopping centers and malls in the Southeastern and Midwestern United States.

cdi-corporation.name: CDI Corporation
cdi-corporation.description: CDI Corporation was a privately held US company headquartered in Houston, Texas, providing engineering, procurement, construction management, and staffing services across various industries including energy and chemical manufacturing.

chs-inc.name: CHS Inc.
chs-inc.description: CHS Inc. is a Fortune 500 secondary cooperative based in Inver Grove Heights, Minnesota. It is owned by agricultural cooperatives and farmers, operating food processing, wholesale, farm supply, financial services, and retail businesses.

citic-press-group.name: CITIC Press Group
citic-press-group.description: CITIC Press Group is a Beijing-based publishing company founded in 1988 and a subsidiary of the state-owned CITIC Group. It engages in digital and physical book retail and provides professional education.

ck-life-sciences.name: CK Life Sciences
ck-life-sciences.description: CK Life Sciences International (Holdings) Inc. is a Hong Kong-based biotechnology company and a subsidiary of CK Hutchison Holdings. It focuses on research, development, commercialization, marketing, and sale of biotechnology products. The chairman is Victor Li Tzar-kuoi.

cleco.name: CLECO
cleco.description: Cleco Corporate Holdings LLC is an electric power company headquartered in Pineville, Louisiana. It operates Cleco Power, a regulated electric utility serving about 290,000 retail customers in Louisiana, and also runs an unregulated wholesale electricity business.

cms-energy.name: CMS Energy
cms-energy.description: CMS Energy Corporation is an American energy company based in Jackson, Michigan. Its main business is Consumers Energy, a public utility providing electricity and natural gas to over 6 million Michigan residents. Consumers Energy has been operating since 1886.

cna-financial.name: CNA Financial
cna-financial.description: CNA Financial Corporation is a financial company based in Chicago, Illinois. Its principal subsidiaries include Continental Casualty Company, founded in 1897, and The Continental Insurance Company, organized in 1853. CNA was incorporated in 1967.

cosco-shipping-international-hong-kong.name: COSCO Shipping International (Hong Kong)
cosco-shipping-international-hong-kong.description: COSCO Shipping International Co., Ltd. is a Hong Kong-listed company and an indirect subsidiary of COSCO Shipping. It engages in ship trading and supplying services and has been listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong since 1992.

cosco-shipping-ports.name: COSCO Shipping Ports
cosco-shipping-ports.description: COSCO Shipping Ports Limited is a Hong Kong-listed company and investor in ports. Formerly known as COSCO Pacific Limited, it is part of COSCO Shipping and is mainly engaged in container terminal operations, container manufacturing and leasing, shipping agency, and freight forwarding.

cra-international.name: CRA International
cra-international.description: CRA International, Inc. is a global consulting firm headquartered in Boston. It provides expert testimony, litigation support, strategic advice, and analysis to law firms, corporations, accounting firms, and governments.

crisil.name: CRISIL
crisil.description: CRISIL Limited is headquartered in Andheri, Mumbai, India. Established in 1987 as India's first credit rating agency, it is now a subsidiary of the American company S&P Global.

csg-holding.name: CSG Holding
csg-holding.description: CSG Holding Limited, formerly China Southern Glass Holding Limited, is the largest architectural glass manufacturer in China. It manufactures and sells various glass products including float, architectural, display, automotive, coated, mirrors, color filter, solar, and conservation glass.

css-industries.name: CSS Industries
css-industries.description: CSS Industries, Inc., founded in 1923 as City Stores Company, is headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The company designs, manufactures, and distributes seasonal and everyday greeting cards and novelties, with showrooms in New York City, Memphis, Minneapolis, and Hong Kong.

cxense.name: CXense
cxense.description: Cxense ASA was a technology company founded in Oslo, Norway in 2010 by John Markus Lervik. In 2019, it was acquired by Piano Software Inc. and subsequently removed from the Oslo Stock Exchange.

cafepress.name: CafePress
cafepress.description: CafePress, Inc. is an American online retailer offering a wide range of consumer items including clothing, home decor, drinkware, stationery, gifts, and customized on-demand products. Founded in San Mateo, California, it is now headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, where its production facility is located. In 2001, CafePress.com won the People's Voice Webby Award in Commerce.

cahya-mata-sarawak-berhad.name: Cahya Mata Sarawak Berhad
cahya-mata-sarawak-berhad.description: Cahya Mata Sarawak Berhad (CMSB) is a Malaysian investment holding company listed on Bursa Malaysia. It operates in Sarawak and is involved in manufacturing cement and construction materials, road construction and maintenance, undersea pipeline laying, dam construction, smelting, property development, financial services, and education.

cal-maine.name: Cal-Maine
cal-maine.description: Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. is an American fresh egg producer based in Ridgeland, Mississippi. Founded in 1957 by Fred R. Adams, Jr., the company is the largest egg producer in the United States and sells eggs under various brand names including Egg-Land's Best and Land O'Lakes.

calgon-carbon.name: Calgon Carbon
calgon-carbon.description: Calgon Carbon Corporation, based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, manufactures and markets products that remove contaminants and odors from liquids and gases. Its products, often using activated carbon, serve industrial, municipal, and consumer markets.

calix.name: Calix
calix.description: Calix, Inc. is a telecommunications company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Jose, California. It specializes in providing software platforms, systems, and services to support the delivery of broadband services.

capricorn-energy.name: Capricorn Energy
capricorn-energy.description: Capricorn Energy plc is a British oil and gas exploration and development company based in Edinburgh, Scotland. It operates in the petroleum industry.

calpine.name: Calpine
calpine.description: Calpine Corporation was a Fortune 500 company based in Houston, Texas. It was the largest generator of electricity from natural gas and geothermal energy in the United States.

camden-property-trust.name: Camden Property Trust
camden-property-trust.description: Camden Property Trust is a publicly traded real estate investment trust investing in apartments across the United States. It is the 14th largest owner of apartments in the country.

camurus.name: Camurus
camurus.description: Camurus AB is a Swedish research-based pharmaceutical and biotechnology company specializing in medicines for serious and chronic diseases. Founded in 1991, it is based in Lund, Sweden, within the Medicon Valley region. The company is publicly listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Mid Cap.

canterbury-park.name: Canterbury Park
canterbury-park.description: Canterbury Park is a horse racing track located in Shakopee, Minnesota, United States. It offers parimutuel wagering on live and simulcast horse races and operates a 24/7 card casino regulated by the Minnesota Racing Commission. The company is also developing approximately 140 acres of surrounding land for mixed-use projects.

capitalsource.name: CapitalSource
capitalsource.description: CapitalSource is a commercial lender in the United States and a division of Pacific Western Bank. It provides senior debt loans ranging from $5 million to $100 million to middle-market companies across various industries including technology, real estate, healthcare, and equipment leasing. The company operates 80 branches in California.

capital-cargo-international-airlines.name: Capital Cargo International Airlines
capital-cargo-international-airlines.description: Capital Cargo International Airlines was a cargo airline based in Orlando, Florida, operating from 1995 to 2013. It provided on-demand and wet lease aircraft charter services, with its main base at Orlando International Airport. The airline was owned by the Air Transport Services Group.

capitol-federal-savings-bank.name: Capitol Federal Savings Bank
capitol-federal-savings-bank.description: Capitol Federal Savings Bank is a federally chartered and insured savings bank headquartered in Topeka, Kansas. Founded in 1893, it operates 51 locations serving the Kansas City metropolitan area in both Kansas and Missouri. The bank is owned by Capitol Federal Financial Inc.

capstone-turbine.name: Capstone Turbine
capstone-turbine.description: Capstone Green Energy Corporation, formerly Capstone Turbine Corporation, is a California-based manufacturer of gas turbines specializing in microturbine power and cogeneration systems. Incorporated in 1988, its turbines use air bearings for maintenance-free operation and eliminate the need for cooling or secondary systems. The technology is fuel flexible and scalable for various applications.

carmax.name: CarMax
carmax.description: CarMax, Inc. is a used vehicle retailer based in the United States. It operates two business segments: CarMax Sales Operations and CarMax Auto Finance. The company started as a side business of Circuit City Corporation in 1993 and operates 263 locations as of November 2026.

carbonite.name: Carbonite
carbonite.description: Carbonite, Inc. is an American company providing online backup services for Windows and macOS users. Acquired by Canadian software company OpenText in 2019, it backs up documents, emails, music, photos, and settings. Carbonite was the first service to offer unlimited backup space for a fixed price.

cargills-ceylon-plc.name: Cargills Ceylon PLC
cargills-ceylon-plc.description: Cargills (Ceylon) PLC is a Sri Lankan consumer company listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. It operates in modern retail, FMCG, and restaurants, and is also involved in banking, real estate, agriculture, and cinema. It runs the largest food-related supply chain in Sri Lanka.

carillion.name: Carillion
carillion.description: Carillion plc was a British multinational construction and facilities management services company headquartered in Wolverhampton, UK. The company was liquidated in January 2018.

carlisle-companies.name: Carlisle Companies
carlisle-companies.description: Carlisle Companies Incorporated supplies construction products that enhance building energy efficiency and resilience. It manufactures single-ply roofing products and accessories for commercial buildings. The company operates two segments and earns more than half its revenue in the United States.

carpenter-technology-corporation.name: Carpenter Technology Corporation
carpenter-technology-corporation.description: Carpenter Technology Corporation develops and manufactures stainless steels and corrosion-resistant alloys including nickel, copper, and titanium, as well as powdered alloys for 3D additive manufacturing. Its products serve aerospace, defense, medical, transportation, energy, and distribution industries.

carpetright.name: Carpetright
carpetright.description: Carpetright is a British carpet retailer founded in 1988 by Lord Philip Harris. It operates in the retail industry and is based in the United Kingdom. The company specializes in selling carpets and related flooring products.

cars-com.name: cars.com
cars-com.description: Cars.com is an automotive classified website focused on the United States, launched in June 1998. It is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, and is known for being the second largest automotive classified site and for having the most expensive domain ever sold.

carter-s.name: Carter's
carter-s.description: Carter's, Inc. is a major American designer and marketer of children's apparel. Founded in 1865 by William Carter, the company operates in the consumer goods and retail industry in the United States.

cascade-microtech.name: Cascade Microtech
cascade-microtech.description: Cascade Microtech is a semiconductor test equipment manufacturer based in Beaverton, Oregon, United States. Founded in 1983, it was formerly publicly traded and is now fully merged with FormFactor, Inc.

casella-waste-systems.name: Casella Waste Systems
casella-waste-systems.description: Casella Waste Systems, Inc. is a waste management company headquartered in Rutland, Vermont, United States. Founded in 1975, it provides integrated solid waste services including collection, disposal, recycling, and organics services primarily in seven northeastern states.

catlin-group.name: Catlin Group
catlin-group.description: Catlin Group Limited was a Bermuda-based specialty insurance and reinsurance company. It operated six underwriting hubs and more than 55 offices worldwide. Catlin owned the largest syndicate at Lloyd's of London based on 2011 gross written premiums and was acquired by XL Group plc in May 2015.

cavium.name: Cavium
cavium.description: Cavium, Inc. was a fabless semiconductor company based in San Jose, California. It specialized in ARM-based and MIPS-based network, video, and security processors and SoCs. The company offered processor- and board-level products targeting routers, switches, appliances, storage, and servers.

cementos-pacasmayo.name: Cementos Pacasmayo
cementos-pacasmayo.description: Pacasmayo is the largest cement company in northern Peru with three cement plants in Piura, Pacasmayo, and Rioja. It has a total annual capacity of 4.9 million tons of cement. The company was founded by Luis Hochschild Plaut.

centene-corporation.name: Centene Corporation
centene-corporation.description: Centene Corporation is an American for-profit healthcare company based in Clayton, Missouri. It serves as an intermediary for government-sponsored and privately insured healthcare programs. Centene ranked No. 23 on the 2025 Fortune 500.

central-depository-services-limited.name: Central Depository Services Limited
central-depository-services-limited.description: Central Depository Services (India) Ltd. (CDSL) is an Indian central securities depository established in 1999. It is headquartered in Lower Parel, Mumbai. CDSL is the primary market infrastructure institution providing depository services in India.

central-pacific-bank.name: Central Pacific Bank
central-pacific-bank.description: Central Pacific Bank (CPB) is an American regional commercial bank operating throughout the state of Hawaii. It provides banking services to the local community.

ceragon.name: Ceragon
ceragon.description: Ceragon Networks Ltd. is an Israeli telecommunications equipment company that manufactures point-to-point and point-to-multipoint wireless connectivity systems. Its products are mainly used for wireless backhaul by mobile network operators, wireless service providers, and private network operators. Ceragon’s systems support transmission across microwave and millimeter wave frequency bands.

cerro-verde.name: Cerro Verde
cerro-verde.description: Cerro Verde is a Peru-based mining company founded in 1970. It focuses on the extraction, exploitation, and production of copper from a porphyry copper deposit near Arequipa. The company also holds copper and molybdenum sale agreements with Sumitomo Metal Mining and Climax Molybdenum Company respectively.

chang-hwa-bank.name: Chang Hwa Bank
chang-hwa-bank.description: Chang Hwa Bank is a Taiwan-based financial institution offering retail and commercial banking services to private and corporate customers. It operates within the banking sector providing various financial services.

changyou.name: Changyou
changyou.description: Changyou.com Ltd. operates online games, primarily massively multiplayer online games, in China. Originally part of Sohu, it was spun off and went public in 2009 through a Cayman Islands-based variable interest entity structure. The company claims independent operation from Sohu since 2007.

changyu-winery.name: Changyu Winery
changyu-winery.description: Changyu Pioneer Wine Co. Inc., located in Yantai, Shandong, is China's oldest and largest winery. Founded in 1892 by Cheong Fatt Tze, it operates in the agriculture and food industry focusing on wine production.

charles-river-laboratories.name: Charles River Laboratories
charles-river-laboratories.description: Charles River Laboratories International, Incorporated is an American life sciences company and contract research organization headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts. Founded in 1947, it supports drug, vaccine, and therapeutic development with research models, drug discovery, safety assessment, and manufacturing services across at least 20 countries.

chartwell-retirement-residences.name: Chartwell Retirement Residences
chartwell-retirement-residences.description: Chartwell Retirement Residences is the largest provider of seniors' housing in Canada, serving over 25,000 residents across Quebec, Ontario, Alberta, and British Columbia. It offers a range of seniors housing communities from independent living to assisted living.

checkpoint-systems.name: Checkpoint Systems
checkpoint-systems.description: Checkpoint Systems is an American company specializing in loss prevention and merchandise visibility for retail companies. It manufactures products like Electronic Article Surveillance systems, RFID hardware and software, and barcode labeling solutions. The company helps retailers manage inventory, prevent theft, and improve replenishment cycles.

chemtura.name: Chemtura
chemtura.description: Chemtura Corporation was a global specialty chemicals company headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, with an executive office in Middlebury, Connecticut. It served industrial sectors including transportation, energy, and electronics, operating manufacturing plants in 11 countries. In 2017, Chemtura was acquired by the German chemical company Lanxess.

chesapeake-utilities.name: Chesapeake Utilities
chesapeake-utilities.description: Chesapeake Utilities Corporation is an American diversified energy company founded in 1947 and headquartered in Delaware. It operates in the Middle-Atlantic, Southeast, and Midwest regions, providing natural gas distribution and transmission, electric distribution, and propane services. The company conducts its business through various operating divisions and subsidiaries.

chico-s-fas.name: Chico's FAS
chico-s-fas.description: Chico's FAS, Inc. is an American women's clothing and accessories retailer founded in 1983 on Sanibel Island, Florida. Headquartered in Fort Myers, Florida, it operates four brands: Chico's, White House Black Market, Soma, and TellTale.

chicony-electronics.name: Chicony Electronics
chicony-electronics.description: Chicony Electronics Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based multinational electronics manufacturer. Its products include input devices, power supplies, digital cameras, webcams, and motherboards for personal computers and notebooks.

chinacache.name: ChinaCache
chinacache.description: ChinaCache, Inc. is a Chinese company founded in 1998 that provides Internet content and application delivery services.

china-automotive-systems.name: China Automotive Systems
china-automotive-systems.description: China Automotive Systems, Inc. is a major Chinese supplier of power steering components and systems. Founded in 1993, it operates through joint ventures in China and a subsidiary in the United States, serving over 60 vehicle manufacturers including FAW Group and Dongfeng Group.

china-bluechemical.name: China BlueChemical
china-bluechemical.description: China BlueChemical Limited is the largest nitrogenous fertilizer manufacturer in mainland China by production volume and energy efficiency. Headquartered in Dongfang, Hainan, it processes natural gas to produce chemical fertilizers and other products. Its parent company is CNOOC, a major petroleum state-owned enterprise in China.

cosco-shipping-holdings-co-ltd.name: Cosco Shipping Holdings Co., Ltd.
cosco-shipping-holdings-co-ltd.description: China COSCO Shipping Corporation Limited is a Chinese state-owned multinational marine transportation conglomerate headquartered in Shanghai. Established in 2016 by merging China Ocean Shipping Company and China Shipping Group Company, it is owned and supervised by the State Council of China.

china-communications-services-corporatio.name: China Communications Services Corporation
china-communications-services-corporatio.description: China Communications Services Corporation Limited, known as China Comservice, is a subsidiary of China Telecommunications Corporation. It provides telecommunication infrastructure and outsourcing services to telecom operators and government organizations in China. The company operates within the telecommunications industry.

china-sandi-holdings.name: China Sandi Holdings
china-sandi-holdings.description: China Sandi Holdings Limited is a public company engaged in ecological forestry in China. It focuses on tree plantation and the manufacture and distribution of timber. The company was formerly known as China Grand Forestry Resources Group Limited.

china-merchants-property.name: China Merchants Property
china-merchants-property.description: China Merchants Property Development Co., Ltd., established in Shenzhen in 1984, is the real estate flagship of China Merchants. It offers residential properties in multiple Chinese cities including Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Beijing. The company operates in the real estate industry.

china-national-materials-group-corporati.name: China National Materials Group Corporation
china-national-materials-group-corporati.description: China National Materials Group, also known as Sinoma, was established in 1983 and is a central government-administered enterprise in China. It is the world's largest cement equipment and engineering service provider and leads China's non-metal materials manufacturing. The company holds core technologies and a complete innovation system in its industry.

china-oilfield-services.name: China Oilfield Services
china-oilfield-services.description: China Oilfield Services (COSL) is an oilfield services company majority owned by the Chinese state-owned CNOOC Group. It has a listed sister company in Hong Kong named CNOOC Limited. The company operates within the petroleum industry.

china-power-international-development.name: China Power International Development
china-power-international-development.description: China Power International Development Limited (CPID) is a Chinese electric power company incorporated in Hong Kong in 2004. It is now under the State Power Investment Corporation after a merger involving its former parent company. CPID operates in the electricity generation sector.

china-resources-gas.name: China Resources Gas
china-resources-gas.description: China Resources Gas Group Limited was incorporated in Hong Kong in 1994. It developed into a city gas distribution business after disposing of previous businesses by 2009. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

china-resources-cement.name: China Resources Cement
china-resources-cement.description: China Resources Cement Holdings Limited, parented by China Resources, is a leading cement and concrete producer in Southern China. Established in 2003 and incorporated in the Cayman Islands, it is the largest NSP clinker and cement producer in Southern China by capacity and second largest concrete producer in China by sales.

china-resources-land.name: China Resources Land
china-resources-land.description: China Resources Land Limited is a property developer under China Resources Group. It develops and manages residential and investment properties in major Mainland China cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen. The company was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange as a red chip stock in 1996.

china-sunergy.name: China Sunergy
china-sunergy.description: China Sunergy CSUN is a Chinese solar cell products manufacturer based in Nanjing, Jiangsu. The company produces solar cells from silicon wafers and has an international customer base. It opened its first international manufacturing base in Turkey in 2013, which is the largest solar cell and module capacity in Turkey and Europe.

china-state-construction-international-h.name: China State Construction International Holdings Limited
china-state-construction-international-h.legal_name: China State Construction International Holdings Limited
china-state-construction-international-h.description: China State Construction International Holdings Limited is the largest construction contractor in Hong Kong. It mainly serves government projects, public organizations, and large private corporations. The company operates primarily through its subsidiaries China State Construction Engineering Limited and China Overseas Limited.

listings.name: China State Construction International Holdings Limited

china-travel-international-investment-ho.name: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong
china-travel-international-investment-ho.legal_name: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong
china-travel-international-investment-ho.description: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Limited is an investment holding company engaged in travel, theme parks, hotels, resorts, passenger transportation, golf clubs, power generation, and freight forwarding. It was established and listed in Hong Kong in 1992 as a subsidiary of China Travel Service.

listings.name: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong

china-water-affairs-group.name: China Water Affairs Group
china-water-affairs-group.description: China Water Affairs Group Limited is a water supply company headquartered in Hong Kong. It was the earliest water company listed in Hong Kong and focuses exclusively on water supply business. The company was formerly an electronics company and changed its name to China Water Affairs Group Limited after restructuring in 2005.

china-zhongwang.name: China Zhongwang
china-zhongwang.description: China Zhongwang Holdings Limited is a Chinese industrial aluminium manufacturer headquartered in Liaoyang, Liaoning Province. It specializes in high-precision and large-section aluminium products for transportation, engineering, and industrial sectors. The company was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2009 but has had suspended trading since 2021.

chong-hing-bank.name: Chong Hing Bank
chong-hing-bank.description: Chong Hing Bank is a bank founded in Hong Kong in 1948 and headquartered in Central. Its back offices are located in Western District and Mong Kok. The bank was owned by the Liu family until it was acquired by the Chinese state-owned Yue Xiu Group in 2014.

chorus-limited.name: Chorus Limited
chorus-limited.description: Chorus is New Zealand's largest telecommunications infrastructure company. It builds and operates nationwide fibre broadband and copper telecommunication networks. The company is listed on the NZX and ASX stock exchanges and is part of the NZX 50 Index.

chow-tai-fook.name: Chow Tai Fook
chow-tai-fook.description: Chow Tai Fook group is a Hong Kong–based privately owned conglomerate with holdings in jewellery, property development, hotels, department stores, transportation, energy, telecommunications, ports, casinos, and other businesses. It has partial stock market listings through associate and subsidiary companies. New World Development, an associate, was ranked 47th-largest by market capitalization on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2018.

church-dwight.name: Church & Dwight
church-dwight.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. is an American consumer packaged goods company headquartered in Ewing Township, New Jersey. It manufactures and markets household, personal-care, and specialty products internationally. The company is best known for its Arm & Hammer brand, which traces back to a business established in 1846.

churchill-downs-incorporated.name: Churchill Downs Incorporated
churchill-downs-incorporated.description: Churchill Downs Incorporated is an American company that owns racetracks, casinos, and an online wagering business. It originated from a single racetrack in Louisville, Kentucky, and has expanded across multiple states. The company is publicly traded and operates in the gambling industry.

chuy-s.name: Chuy's
chuy-s.description: Chuy's Opco, Inc. is an American Tex-Mex restaurant chain founded in 1982 in Austin, Texas. As of 2024, it operates 101 restaurants across 15 states including Texas, Florida, and Virginia. The chain was founded by Mike Young and John Zapp.

chyron-corporation.name: Chyron Corporation
chyron-corporation.description: The Chyron Corporation is an American broadcast graphics and real-time data visualization company based in Melville, New York. Founded in 1966, it designs software and hardware for television production, including character generators and virtual graphics. It merged with Hego AB in 2013 and returned to its original name in 2021.

cia-hering.name: Cia. Hering
cia-hering.description: Companhia Hering is a Brazilian textile and retail clothing company founded in 1880 in Blumenau, Santa Catarina. It is the leading clothing textile company in Latin America with 805 stores. The company remains headquartered in Blumenau and is the major employer in the city.

cincinnati-financial.name: Cincinnati Financial
cincinnati-financial.description: Cincinnati Financial Corporation is a U.S. company offering property and casualty insurance through its subsidiaries. It holds 1.01% of the domestic property and casualty insurance premiums, ranking it as the 20th largest insurance company by market share in the United States.

citi-trends.name: Citi Trends
citi-trends.description: Citi Trends, Inc. is an American retail clothing chain that sells discounted products primarily targeted at African-American customers. It operates in the retail sector within the United States.

claro-colombia.name: Claro Colombia
claro-colombia.description: Claro Colombia is a telecommunications operator based in Colombia and owned by the Mexican group América Móvil. It is the largest provider of mobile phone services in Colombia, with a majority share of the country's mobile phone subscribers as of 2011.

clean-harbors.name: Clean Harbors
clean-harbors.description: Clean Harbors, Inc. is a waste management and industrial services provider headquartered in Norwell, Massachusetts, USA. It specializes in hazardous and non-hazardous waste services and owns Safety-Kleen, the largest used oil re-refiner and recycler in North America.

clearwater-paper.name: Clearwater Paper
clearwater-paper.description: Clearwater Paper Corporation is an American manufacturer of pulp and paperboard headquartered in Spokane, Washington. The company was established in 2008 as a spin-off from Potlatch Corporation.

clicksoftware-technologies.name: ClickSoftware Technologies
clicksoftware-technologies.description: ClickSoftware was a US-based technology company providing field service management software from 1997 until its acquisition by Salesforce in 2019.

coca-cola-consolidated-inc.name: Coca-Cola Consolidated, Inc.
coca-cola-consolidated-inc.description: Coca-Cola Consolidated, Inc. is the largest independent Coca-Cola bottler in the United States, headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.

cochlear-limited.name: Cochlear Limited
cochlear-limited.description: Cochlear Limited is an Australian medical device company that designs, manufactures, and supplies implantable hearing systems including cochlear implants and bone conduction hearing systems.

code-rebel.name: Code Rebel
code-rebel.description: Code Rebel Corporation was an American technology company based in Kahului, Hawaii. It developed and sold computer software, focusing on terminal services and virtualization software mainly for Apple products. The company was founded by Arben Kane.

codexis.name: Codexis
codexis.description: Codexis, Inc. is a protein engineering company based in the United States. It develops enzymes used in pharmaceutical, food, and medical applications. The company specializes in protein engineering technologies.

coinstar.name: Coinstar
coinstar.description: Coinstar, LLC is an American company that operates coin-cashing machines. It provides automated services for converting coins into cash or other forms of payment. The company is based in the United States.

collabrx.name: CollabRx
collabrx.description: CollabRx, Inc. was a company offering cloud-based expert systems for selecting clinical treatments for molecular diseases like cancer. Its technology used dynamically updated molecular disease models informed by a network of academic and medical advisors. The company focused on distilling clinically relevant therapy approaches from biological data.

colliers-international.name: Colliers International
colliers-international.description: Colliers International Group Inc. is a Canadian diversified professional services and investment management company. It has approximately 29,000 employees and operates in more than 400 offices across 65 countries. The company is based in Canada.

colonial-properties.name: Colonial Properties
colonial-properties.description: Colonial Properties Trust was a publicly traded diversified real estate investment trust headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama. In October 2013, it was acquired by Mid-America Apartment Communities. The company operated in the real estate investment sector.

comfort-systems-usa.name: Comfort Systems USA
comfort-systems-usa.description: Comfort Systems USA, Inc. is an American company providing mechanical and electrical contracting services. Its offerings include HVAC, plumbing, piping and controls, off-site construction, monitoring, fire protection, and electrical system installation and servicing.

commscope.name: CommScope
commscope.description: CommScope Holding Company, Inc. is an American network infrastructure provider based in Claremont, North Carolina. The company employs over 22,000 people and joined the Nasdaq stock exchange in 2013.

commvault-systems.name: CommVault Systems
commvault-systems.description: Commvault Systems, Inc. is an American publicly traded company specializing in cybersecurity and data protection software. Its services include data security, cloud management, and infrastructure management.

commerce-bancshares.name: Commerce Bancshares
commerce-bancshares.description: Commerce Bancshares, Inc. is a regional bank holding company headquartered in Missouri with principal offices in Kansas City and St. Louis. It is the parent company of Commerce Bank, which offers a diversified range of financial services including business and personal banking, wealth management, and investments.

commercial-bank-of-ceylon.name: Commercial Bank of Ceylon
commercial-bank-of-ceylon.description: Commercial Bank of Ceylon PLC is a licensed private commercial bank in Sri Lanka, listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. It is the largest private bank in Sri Lanka by net worth and capital, and operates a network of 291 branches and around 948 ATMs across the country.

community-bank-n-a.name: Community Bank, N.A.
community-bank-n-a.description: Community Bank, N.A. is a commercial bank in the United States serving customers in Upstate New York, Northeastern Pennsylvania, Lehigh Valley, Vermont, and Massachusetts. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Community Financial System, Inc. and is headquartered in DeWitt, New York.

companhia-brasileira-de-aluminio.name: Companhia Brasileira de Aluminio
companhia-brasileira-de-aluminio.description: Companhia Brasileira de Alumínio is the largest aluminium producer in Brazil. It claims an annual production of around 360,000 tonnes as of 2026.

compass-minerals.name: Compass Minerals
compass-minerals.description: Compass Minerals International, Inc. is an American company based in Overland Park, Kansas. It produces minerals such as salt, magnesium chloride, and sulfate of potash, supplying highway deicing salt in North America and the UK, as well as plant nutrition products worldwide.

compugen-ltd.name: Compugen Ltd.
compugen-ltd.description: Compugen Ltd. is an Israeli clinical-stage drug discovery and development company focused on oncology and immunology. Established in 1993 as a computational drug discovery service provider, it is publicly traded on NASDAQ and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

conn-s.name: Conn's
conn-s.description: Conn's, Inc. was an American retail chain specializing in furniture, mattresses, electronics, and appliances. Headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas, it operated stores across multiple states including Texas, Alabama, Arizona, and others.

constant-contact.name: Constant Contact
constant-contact.description: Constant Contact, Inc. is an online marketing company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It has additional offices in several US cities and internationally in Australia, Canada, and England. The company provides software as a service focused on online marketing.

continental-resources.name: Continental Resources
continental-resources.description: Continental Resources, Inc. is an American petroleum and natural gas exploration and production company based in Oklahoma City. Founded in 1967 as Shelly Dean Oil Company, it was renamed Continental Resources in 1990. The company uses hydraulic fracturing and directional drilling and was acquired by affiliates of its founder in 2022.

control4.name: Control4
control4.description: Control4 is a home automation brand offering customizable smart home systems that control devices like lighting, audio, and security. Founded in 2003 in Draper, Utah, it relocated to Lehi, Utah in 2023 and operates as a division of ADI Global Distribution. Control4's platform supports over 13,000 third-party products worldwide.

cookpad-inc.name: Cookpad Inc.
cookpad-inc.description: Cookpad Inc. is a Japanese food tech company operating Japan's largest recipe sharing service, Cookpad. It has its global headquarters in Bristol, UK, and offices worldwide. The company went public on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in 2009 and hosts millions of user-created recipes.

cooper-standard-automotive.name: Cooper-Standard Automotive
cooper-standard-automotive.description: Cooper Standard Automotive Inc. is a global supplier of automotive systems and components headquartered in Novi, Michigan. Its products include rubber and plastic sealing, fuel and brake lines, and anti-vibration systems. The company operates manufacturing locations worldwide and has historical production of M1 Carbines during World War II.

core-laboratories.name: Core Laboratories
core-laboratories.description: Core Laboratories Inc is an American service provider specializing in core and fluid analysis for the petroleum industry. Established in 1936, it offers proprietary reservoir description and production enhancement services globally for oil and gas companies.

corficolombiana.name: Corficolombiana
corficolombiana.description: Corficolombiana is a Colombian financial products company serving some of the largest corporations in Colombia. It operates in the financial services sector within Colombia.

costain-group.name: Costain Group
costain-group.description: Costain Group plc is a British construction and engineering company headquartered in London, England. It operates in the civil engineering sector.

countryside-properties.name: Countryside Properties
countryside-properties.description: Countryside Partnerships plc is a UK housebuilding and urban regeneration company operating mainly in London and the South East of England, with presence in the North West. It was formerly listed on the London Stock Exchange until 2022.

coupa.name: Coupa
coupa.description: Coupa Software Incorporated is an American technology platform headquartered in Foster City, California, providing AI-driven total spend management and supply chain solutions. It has offices across Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific.

cousins-properties.name: Cousins Properties
cousins-properties.description: Cousins Properties Incorporated is an American publicly traded real estate investment trust investing in office buildings across several U.S. cities including Atlanta and Charlotte. It has developed notable properties such as CNN Center and 191 Peachtree Tower.

covisint.name: Covisint
covisint.description: Covisint was an American information technology company acquired by Canadian firm OpenText in July 2017. OpenText's Business Network focuses on integrating, managing, and securely exchanging data across people, systems, and things. Covisint operated in the IT sector prior to its acquisition.

crane-co.name: Crane Co.
crane-co.description: Crane Co. is an American industrial products company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. Founded in 1855, it transitioned into a holding company with diverse segments including Aerospace & Electronics, Engineered Materials, Fluid Handling, and Controls. It serves industries such as chemical, construction, aviation, and power generation.

credit-corp-group.name: Credit Corp Group
credit-corp-group.description: Credit Corp Group is an Australian company specializing in debt collection and debt purchasing. It operates in Australia, New Zealand, and the United States. The company is part of the banking and fintech industry.

crombie-reit.name: Crombie REIT
crombie-reit.description: Crombie REIT is a Canadian publicly traded real estate investment trust based in New Glasgow, Nova Scotia. It trades on the Toronto Stock Exchange as an unincorporated open-ended REIT. The company operates in the real estate investment sector.

crown-holdings.name: Crown Holdings
crown-holdings.description: Crown Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational packaging company headquartered in Tampa, Florida. It designs and manufactures rigid-metal packaging such as aluminum beverage cans and metal food cans, and was founded in 1892 as the Crown Cork & Seal Company.

crumbs-bake-shop.name: Crumbs Bake Shop
crumbs-bake-shop.description: Crumbs Bake Shop is an online store and former bakery chain headquartered in New York City. Founded in 2003 as a small bakery on Manhattan's Upper West Side, it expanded to 79 locations across ten states and Washington, D.C.

cubist-pharmaceuticals.name: Cubist Pharmaceuticals
cubist-pharmaceuticals.description: Cubist Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was an American biopharmaceutical company focused on targeting pathogens such as MRSA.

cuckoo-electronics.name: Cuckoo Electronics
cuckoo-electronics.description: Cuckoo Electronics Co., Ltd. is a home appliance maker headquartered in Yangsan, South Korea. Founded in 1978 as Sungkwang Electronics, it changed its corporate identity to Cuckoo in 2002, reflecting its major export brand name.

cumulus-media.name: Cumulus Media
cumulus-media.description: Cumulus Media, Inc. is a broadcasting company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It is the second largest owner and operator of AM and FM radio stations in the United States and owns Westwood One.

cvent.name: Cvent
cvent.description: Cvent Holding Corp. is a company based in Tysons Corner, Virginia, that provides software-as-a-service for meetings, events, and hospitality management.

cybozu.name: Cybozu
cybozu.description: Cybozu, Inc. is a Tokyo-based software company that provides web-based groupware services such as Cybozu Office and kintone. It has offices in Tokyo, Matsuyama, Osaka, and subsidiaries in Vietnam, China, Australia, and the United States. The U.S. subsidiary, kintone Corporation, is located in San Francisco.

cyclacel.name: Cyclacel
cyclacel.description: Cyclacel Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a biotechnology firm based in Dundee, Scotland, and Short Hills, New Jersey. It develops cancer drugs and treatments and was founded in 1996 by David Lane, Merlin Ventures, Cancer Research Campaign Technology, and the Universities of Dundee and Glasgow.

cynapsus-therapeutics.name: Cynapsus Therapeutics
cynapsus-therapeutics.description: Cynapsus Therapeutics Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It develops a drug to treat the motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease and was formerly named Cannasat Therapeutics before changing its name in 2010.

cytrx.name: CytRx
cytrx.description: CytRx Corp. is a biopharmaceutical research and development oncology company based in Los Angeles, California. It focuses on oncology-related biopharmaceutical research and development.

cytec-industries.name: Cytec Industries
cytec-industries.description: Cytec Industries Incorporated was a specialty chemicals and materials technology company based in Woodland Park, New Jersey. It produced resins, plastics, and composite materials, especially for aerospace and specialty material users, and was spun off from American Cyanamid Company.

china-tower.name: China Tower
china-tower.description: China Tower Corporation Limited is a state-owned telecommunications company in China. It provides telecommunication tower construction, maintenance, ancillary facilities management, and other related services across mainland China.

chubu-nippon-broadcasting.name: Chubu-Nippon Broadcasting
chubu-nippon-broadcasting.description: Chubu-Nippon Broadcasting Co., Ltd. is a regional radio and television group serving Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. Its radio service is affiliated with the Japan Radio Network, and its television service is affiliated with TBS and the Japan News Network.

christian-dior.name: Christian Dior
christian-dior.description: Christian Dior SE, commonly known as Dior, is a French multinational corporation and fashion house specializing in luxury goods. Founded in 1946 by Christian Dior, it produces haute couture items. Its clothing line is managed by Christian Dior Couture, a subsidiary of LVMH.

china-jinmao.name: China Jinmao
china-jinmao.description: China Jinmao Holdings Group Limited is a real estate developer incorporated and headquartered in Hong Kong. It is a subsidiary of the state-owned Sinochem Corporation and operates mainly in Mainland China cities such as Shanghai, Beijing, and Zhuhai. The company was formerly known as Franshion Properties (China) Limited.

cj-enm.name: CJ ENM
cj-enm.description: CJ ENM Co., Ltd is a South Korean entertainment and retail company founded in 1994.

cssc-offshore-marine-engineering-company.name: CSSC Offshore & Marine Engineering Company
cssc-offshore-marine-engineering-company.description: CSSC Offshore & Marine Engineering (Group) Company Limited, formerly Guangzhou Shipyard International Company Limited, is a state-owned shipbuilding enterprise based in Southern China. It is the largest modern integrated shipbuilding company in the region.

compass-pathways.name: Compass Pathways
compass-pathways.description: Compass Pathways is a British pharmaceutical company developing psychedelics as potential medicines. Its main drug candidate, psilocybin (COMP360), has completed phase 3 clinical trials for treatment-resistant depression and received breakthrough therapy status from the U.S. FDA.

croatian-postal-bank.name: Croatian Postal Bank
croatian-postal-bank.description: Hrvatska poštanska banka d.d. (HPB) is the largest Croatian-owned bank in Croatia. It ranks fifth in the country in terms of total assets. The bank operates within the Croatian banking sector.

ca-technologies.name: CA Technologies
ca-technologies.description: CA Technologies, formerly Computer Associates International, Inc., was an American multinational enterprise software developer and publisher from 1976 to 2018. It created system software for IBM mainframe, distributed computing, virtual machine, and cloud computing environments.

cyient.name: Cyient
cyient.description: Cyient is an Indian multinational technology company focused on engineering, manufacturing, data analytics, networks, and operations. It was established in 1991 in Hyderabad as Infotech Enterprises Ltd and rebranded as Cyient in 2014.

capita.name: Capita
capita.description: Capita plc is a business process outsourcing and professional services company headquartered in London. It is the largest in the UK with clients in government and private sectors and operates across Europe, Africa, and Asia. It also has a property and infrastructure consultancy division.

california-resources-corporation.name: California Resources Corporation
california-resources-corporation.description: California Resources Corporation is an American energy company focused on hydrocarbon exploration in California. It is organized in Delaware and headquartered in Long Beach, California. The company holds the largest privately owned mineral acreage position in the state of California.

calamp.name: CalAmp
calamp.description: CalAmp Corporation is a provider of Internet of Things software applications, cloud services, and telematics products based in Irvine, California. Its technology includes edge computing devices and SaaS applications for fleet telematics. The company owns patents for the LoJack Stolen Vehicle Recovery System.

cadence-design-systems.name: Cadence Design Systems
cadence-design-systems.description: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. is an American multinational technology and computational software company headquartered in San Jose, California. It specializes in electronic design automation software and hardware for integrated circuits, systems on chips, and printed circuit boards. It also develops molecular modeling applications for pharmaceutical drug developers.

colgate-palmolive-company.name: Colgate-Palmolive Company
colgate-palmolive-company.description: The Colgate-Palmolive Company is an American multinational consumer products company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. It specializes in household, health care, personal care, and veterinary products.

celesc.name: Celesc
celesc.description: Centrais Elétricas de Santa Catarina (Celesc) is an electricity utility serving the southern Brazilian state of Santa Catarina. Headquartered in Florianópolis, it operates 16 hydroelectric plants and manages an extensive distribution network.

cj-cheil-jedang.name: CJ Cheil Jedang
cj-cheil-jedang.description: CJ CheilJedang Corporation is a South Korean international food company based in Seoul. It manufactures food ingredients, packaged food products, pharmaceuticals, and biotechnology products. Its brands include Beksul, Bibigo, Gourmet, and Hetbahn, with Bibigo known globally for mandu.

core-main.name: Core & Main
core-main.description: Core & Main is a U.S.-based distributor of products used for water, wastewater, storm drainage, and fire protection. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, it serves municipalities, private water companies, and contractors across 49 states. The company operates 370 branch locations nationwide.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.description: Cerebras Systems Inc. is a company based in Sunnyvale, California, that develops semiconductors, supercomputers, and software for artificial intelligence deep-learning applications. Its products include wafer scale engine semiconductors, CS-3 supercomputers, and cloud APIs for AI inference and training. The company also builds data centers to provide cloud computing services.

canadian-imperial-bank-of-commerce.name: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce
canadian-imperial-bank-of-commerce.description: The Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce is a Canadian multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Toronto's Financial District. It was formed in 1961 through the merger of the Canadian Bank of Commerce and the Imperial Bank of Canada. It is one of the Big Five banks founded in Toronto.

clariant.name: Clariant
clariant.description: Clariant AG is a Swiss multinational specialty chemical company headquartered in Muttenz, Switzerland. It was formed in 1995 as a spin-off from Sandoz and has 68 subsidiaries in 36 countries. The company operates major manufacturing sites across Europe, the Americas, China, and India.

ctf-services-limited.name: CTF Services Limited
ctf-services-limited.description: CTF Services Limited is a conglomerate with a diversified portfolio of market-leading businesses in Hong Kong and mainland China under Chow Tai Fook Enterprise. Its operations include toll roads, financial services, logistics, construction, and facilities management.

cpc-corporation-taiwan.name: CPC Corporation, Taiwan
cpc-corporation-taiwan.description: The CPC Corporation is a state-owned petroleum, natural gas, and gasoline company in Taiwan. It is the core of the Taiwanese petrochemicals industry.

caladrius-biosciences.name: Caladrius Biosciences
caladrius-biosciences.description: Lisata Therapeutics is an American clinical stage pharmaceutical company focused on oncology. It was formed in September 2022 through a merger of Cend Therapeutics and Caladrius Biosciences.

cinemark.name: Cinemark
cinemark.description: Cinemark Holdings, Inc. is an American movie theater chain headquartered in Plano, Texas. Founded in 1977, it operates hundreds of theaters across the Americas and is the largest movie theater chain in Brazil with a 30% market share.

cheung-kong-holdings.name: Cheung Kong Holdings
cheung-kong-holdings.description: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Limited was a multinational conglomerate based in Hong Kong. It merged with its subsidiary Hutchison Whampoa on June 3, 2015, to become part of CK Hutchison Holdings. It was one of Hong Kong's leading multinational conglomerates.

coach.name: Coach
coach.description: Coach New York, commonly known as Coach, is an American fashion house headquartered in New York City. It specializes in handbags, luggage, accessories, and ready-to-wear clothing. The company licenses its name for eyewear and fragrances and has had Stuart Vevers as executive creative director since June 2013.

carrier-corporation.name: Carrier Corporation
carrier-corporation.description: Carrier Global Corporation is an American multinational company based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, manufacturing HVAC, refrigeration, and fire and security equipment. Founded in 1915, it expanded from HVAC systems to commercial refrigeration and fire technologies.

comscore.name: Comscore
comscore.description: Comscore, Inc. is an American global media measurement and analytics company providing marketing data and analytics to enterprises, advertising agencies, brand marketers, and publishers.

covivio.name: Covivio
covivio.industry: Rental of land and other real estate
covivio.description: Covivio is a French real estate company founded in 1998. It operates in the rental of land and other real estate sector.

china-resources-power.name: China Resources Power
china-resources-power.description: China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited, incorporated in Hong Kong in 2001, is a subsidiary of China Resources Holdings. It invests in, develops, operates, and manages coal-burning power plants across multiple regions in China including Beijing and Guangdong.

cspc-pharmaceutical-group.name: CSPC Pharmaceutical Group
cspc-pharmaceutical-group.description: CSPC Pharmaceutical Group researches, develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceutical products. The company is headquartered in Hebei Province, China.

cabot-corporation.name: Cabot Corporation
cabot-corporation.description: Cabot Corporation is an American specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It operates in over 20 countries with multiple manufacturing plants, research facilities, and sales offices.

china-yangtze-power.name: China Yangtze Power
china-yangtze-power.description: China Yangtze Power Co., Ltd., known as Yangtze Power, is a Chinese utilities company headquartered in Beijing. It is part of the SSE 180 Index and controlled by China Three Gorges Corporation, a state-owned enterprise.

campari-group.name: Campari Group
campari-group.description: Campari Group, officially Davide Campari-Milano N.V., is an Italian company active since 1860 in the branded beverage industry. It produces spirits, wines, and non-alcoholic apéritifs. Its portfolio includes over 50 brands such as Campari, Aperol, SKYY vodka, and Wild Turkey.

capital-small-finance-bank.name: Capital Small Finance Bank
capital-small-finance-bank.description: Capital Small Finance Bank is an Indian small finance bank founded in April 2016. It is headquartered in Jalandhar, India. The bank focuses on providing financial services within the country.

cleanaway-waste-management-limited.name: Cleanaway Waste Management Limited
cleanaway-waste-management-limited.description: Cleanaway Waste Management Limited is an Australian waste management company founded in 1979 by Brambles. It operates extensively in Australia with thousands of trucks and branches. It is the largest waste management business in Australia.

cogeco.name: Cogeco
cogeco.description: Cogeco Inc. is a Canadian telecommunications and media company headquartered in Montreal, Quebec. It operates three business units providing cable television, radio and TV broadcasting, telephony, and Internet services in Ontario, Quebec, and thirteen U.S. states along the east coast.

cnooc-limited.name: CNOOC Limited
cnooc-limited.description: CNOOC Limited is China's largest producer of offshore crude oil and natural gas. It is a major subsidiary of China National Offshore Oil Corporation and has been listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2001. The company was also listed on the New York and Toronto Stock Exchanges until 2021 and is part of the Hang Seng Index.

celsys.name: Celsys
celsys.description: Celsys is a Japanese graphics software company known for developing Clip Studio Paint, a software family used for digital comics, illustration, and 2D animation. The software is available on multiple platforms including macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android.

city-chic-collective.name: City Chic Collective
city-chic-collective.description: City Chic Collective is an Australian retail clothing company headquartered in Alexandria, Sydney. Founded in 1992 and rebranded in 2006, it operates 90 stores in Australia and New Zealand and a global online store specializing in plus-sized women's clothing.

celgene.name: Celgene
celgene.description: Celgene Corporation is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Summit, New Jersey. It produces cancer and immunology drugs, with its major product being Revlimid, used to treat multiple myeloma and certain anemias. Since 2019, it has been a subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb.

calbee.name: Calbee
calbee.description: Calbee, Inc. is a Japanese snack food maker headquartered in Marunouchi, Tokyo. Founded in 1949 in Hiroshima, it holds about 70% of Japan's potato chip market and sells products across Asia and the United States. It has been listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange since 2011.

copa-airlines.name: Copa Airlines
copa-airlines.description: Compañía Panameña de Aviación, S.A., branded as Copa Airlines, is the flag carrier of Panama headquartered in Panama City. It is a member of the Star Alliance and owned by Copa Holdings, which also owns Colombian airline AeroRepública.

cava-group.name: Cava Group
cava-group.description: Cava is an American Mediterranean fast casual restaurant chain with locations across the United States. Owned by the publicly traded Cava Group, it acquired Zoës Kitchen in 2018 and is the largest operator in the Mediterranean restaurant category in the U.S. It also produces Mediterranean dips and dressings sold in grocery stores.

cardinal-health.name: Cardinal Health
cardinal-health.description: Cardinal Health is an American multinational health care services company headquartered in Dublin, Ohio. It specializes in distributing pharmaceuticals and medical products, manufacturing medical and surgical products, and operates a large network of radiopharmacies in the U.S.

cipla.name: Cipla
cipla.description: Cipla Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It focuses on medications for various diseases and conditions, operates 47 manufacturing locations worldwide, and sells products in 86 countries.

cf-industries.name: CF Industries
cf-industries.description: CF Industries Holdings, Inc. is an American manufacturer and distributor of agricultural fertilizers based in Northbrook, Illinois. Founded in 1946, it was originally a federation of regional agricultural supply cooperatives before becoming a publicly traded company.

cansino-biologics.name: CanSino Biologics
cansino-biologics.description: CanSino Biologics, also known as CanSinoBIO, is a Chinese company specializing in vaccine development. It operates within the pharmaceutical industry and is based in China.

clorox.name: Clorox
clorox.description: The Clorox Company is an American multinational that manufactures and markets consumer and professional products. It is based in the United States and has been listed on the Fortune 500 list annually from 2000 to 2024.

china-minsheng-bank.name: China Minsheng Bank
china-minsheng-bank.description: China Minsheng Bank is a major Chinese bank founded in 1996 by Jing Shuping. It was the first bank in China established with private sector shareholders, reflecting economic reforms led by Premier Zhu Rongji.

crocs-inc.name: Crocs, Inc.
crocs-inc.description: Crocs, Inc. is an American footwear company based in Broomfield, Colorado, known for manufacturing and marketing foam footwear called "clogs." In 2021, it acquired the Italian footwear brand HEYDUDE.

cision.name: Cision
cision.description: Cision Ltd. is a public relations and earned media software company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It offers services including PRNewswire, PRWeb, Brandwatch, and Canada Newswire.

consol-energy.name: Consol Energy
consol-energy.description: Consol Energy Inc. is an American energy company focused on coal, headquartered near Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It employs over 1,600 people.

confluent-inc.name: Confluent Inc.
confluent-inc.description: Confluent, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Mountain View, California. The company operates in the technology sector.

chiyoda-corporation.name: Chiyoda Corporation
chiyoda-corporation.hq: Minato Mirai Grand Central Tower, Japan
chiyoda-corporation.description: Chiyoda Corporation is a global engineering company specializing in oil and gas midstream, downstream refinery, and petrochemicals facilities design and construction. It is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan, with engineering offices abroad. Most of its business occurs outside Japan.

camuzzi-gas.name: Camuzzi Gas
camuzzi-gas.description: Camuzzi Gas is an Argentine natural gas distribution company operating through subsidiaries in southern provinces and Buenos Aires province. It covers 45% of Argentina's concession areas and serves 2 million customers.

canoo.name: Canoo
canoo.description: Canoo Inc. was an American automotive company based in Torrance, California, that developed and manufactured electric vehicles. Its research and development was in Michigan, with production in Texas. The company filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy on January 17, 2025.

cebu-pacific.name: Cebu Pacific
cebu-pacific.description: Cebu Air, Inc., operating as Cebu Pacific, is a Philippine low-cost airline based in Pasay, Metro Manila. Founded in 1988, it is the first low-cost carrier in Asia and the largest airline in the Philippines by fleet size, operating flights from five bases.

carrefour-brazil.name: Carrefour Brazil
carrefour-brazil.description: Grupo Carrefour Brasil, operating as Atacadão S.A., is a Brazilian retail company controlled by the French Carrefour group. It owns several brands including Atacadão, the largest wholesaler in Brazil, and is the largest food retail company in the country.

comision-federal-de-electricidad.name: Comisión Federal de Electricidad
comision-federal-de-electricidad.industry: Electric power generation, transmission and distribution
comision-federal-de-electricidad.description: The Comisión Federal de Electricidad (CFE) is Mexico's state-owned electric utility responsible for the national electric industry. It operates under the Mexican constitution's mandate and is known for its slogan "Una empresa de clase mundial."

c-a.name: C&A
c-a.description: C&A is a European designer and retailer specializing in fast fashion, focusing on casual wear. It operates approximately 1,250 stores in Europe and 330 in Brazil, with online shopping websites. In Brazil, it operates through a joint venture, and it licenses the C&A name for stores in Mexico and China under different ownership.

currys-plc.name: Currys plc
currys-plc.description: Currys plc is a British multinational retailer and services company specializing in electrical and telecommunications products. Headquartered in Newark-on-Trent, England, it was formed in 2014 by merging Dixons Retail and Carphone Warehouse Group. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

clarin-group.name: Clarín Group
clarin-group.description: Grupo Clarín S.A. is an Argentine media conglomerate headquartered in Buenos Aires. It operates in the mass media industry within Argentina. The company is a significant player in the country's media sector.

cellnex-telecom.name: Cellnex Telecom
cellnex-telecom.description: Cellnex Telecom is a Spanish telecommunications infrastructure and services company operating over 110,000 sites across ten European countries. It provides shared infrastructure primarily to mobile network operators and offers services including distributed antenna systems, small cells, broadcast networks, and fiber connectivity.

cerveceria-nacional-dominicana.name: Cervecería Nacional Dominicana
cerveceria-nacional-dominicana.description: Cervecería Nacional Dominicana is the primary beer producer in the Dominican Republic, founded in 1929. Owned by AmBev and Grupo León Jimenes, it was the first brewery in the country and produces brands like Presidente and Bohemia Especial.

colian-holding.name: Colian Holding
colian-holding.description: Colian Holding S.A. is a corporate group specialized in the food industry controlled by Jan Kolański. Its headquarters are located in Opatówek near Kalisz, Poland. The company operates in the food industry sector.

cargojet.name: Cargojet
cargojet.description: Cargojet Inc. is a scheduled cargo airline based in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. It operates cargo services domestically and internationally, including full aircraft charters, with its main base at John C. Munro Hamilton International Airport.

compagnie-miniere-d-akouta.name: Compagnie minière d'Akouta
compagnie-miniere-d-akouta.description: COMINAK is a national uranium mining company based in Niger. It operates in the uranium mining industry within the country.

cervejas-de-mocambique.name: Cervejas De Moçambique
cervejas-de-mocambique.description: Cervejas de Moçambique (CDM) is a Mozambican beer brewing group and a subsidiary of Anheuser-Busch InBev. It holds all major Mozambican beer brands and controls approximately 94% of the local beer market.

calpis.name: Calpis
calpis.description: Calpis Co., Ltd., based in Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan, manufactures Calpis, a probiotic milk beverage known as Calpico in North America. The drink has a light, milky, and slightly acidic flavor and is produced through lactic acid fermentation using ingredients like water, dry milk, and lactic acid.

canadian-western-bank.name: Canadian Western Bank
canadian-western-bank.description: Canadian Western Bank, also known as CWB Financial Group, was a Canadian bank based in Edmonton, Alberta. It primarily operated in western Canada with several branches in eastern Canada.

coway-co-ltd.name: Coway Co., Ltd.
coway-co-ltd.description: Coway Co., Ltd. is a South Korean manufacturer of household appliances including water purifiers, air purifiers, bidets, water softeners, and mattresses. Founded and headquartered in Seoul, it is the largest company in its product categories in South Korea and has subsidiaries worldwide.

compuware.name: Compuware
compuware.description: Compuware was an American software company based in Detroit. It developed enterprise software mainly for mainframe computing and provided related services such as software testing, development, and performance management.

corus-entertainment.name: Corus Entertainment
corus-entertainment.description: Corus Entertainment Holdings Inc. is a Canadian mass media, television production, and distribution company headquartered at Corus Quay in Toronto, Ontario. Founded in 1987 as Shaw Radio Ltd., it was spun off from Shaw Communications in 1999 and holds assets in radio, publishing, and television industries.

cab-payments.name: CAB Payments
cab-payments.description: CAB Payments Holdings plc is a British company specializing in payment processing and foreign exchange services. It is based in the United Kingdom and is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange.

coal-india.name: Coal India
coal-india.description: Coal India Limited is an Indian state-owned coal mining company headquartered in Kolkata. It is the largest coal producer in the world by output and operates under the administrative control of the Ministry of Coal. The company is involved in coal mining.

corby-distilleries.name: Corby Distilleries
corby-distilleries.description: Corby Spirit and Wine Limited is a Canadian alcohol manufacturing and distribution company founded in 1859 in Corbyville, Ontario. It is partly owned by Pernod Ricard and distills Canadian specialties while marketing Pernod Ricard's products in Canada. The company is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
