coopervision.name: CooperVision
coopervision.description: CooperVision is an American company that manufactures soft contact lenses and is a business unit of The Cooper Companies. Founded in 1980 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California, its products are sold in over 100 countries. It has manufacturing locations worldwide and major distribution centers in the UK, US, and Belgium.

cobalt-international-energy.name: Cobalt International Energy
cobalt-international-energy.description: Cobalt International Energy, Inc. is a development stage petroleum exploration and production company headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company filed for bankruptcy on December 14, 2017.

coolbrands-international.name: CoolBrands International
coolbrands-international.description: CoolBrands International was a Canadian frozen food and dessert company based in Markham, Ontario. The company specialized in frozen food products and desserts.

cpl-resources.name: CPL Resources
cpl-resources.description: CPL Resources is a human resources company based in Dublin, operating in Ireland and Europe. Founded in 1992, it has 12 companies across 21 offices in the Republic of Ireland, Northern Ireland, and other parts of Europe.

computacenter.name: Computacenter
computacenter.description: Computacenter plc is a British multinational information technology services provider based in Hatfield, Hertfordshire. It serves both public- and private-sector customers. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

cdv-software-entertainment.name: cdv Software Entertainment
cdv-software-entertainment.description: CDV Software Entertainment AG was a German video game publisher founded in 1989 in Karlsruhe. It was once the largest German publisher in the video game market and became a Frankfurt stock market traded company in 2000. The company filed for bankruptcy in April 2010 after financial difficulties.

coca-cola-enterprises.name: Coca-Cola Enterprises
coca-cola-enterprises.description: Coca-Cola Enterprises was a marketer, producer, and distributor of Coca-Cola products. It served as the anchor bottler for Western Europe and most of North America.

compania-general-de-electricidad.name: Compañia General de Electricidad
compania-general-de-electricidad.description: Compañia General de Electricidad (CGE) is a Chilean utility company operating in electricity, natural gas, and other services. It is based in Chile and listed on the Santiago Stock Exchange. The company serves the energy sector.

calatrava-capital-s-a.name: Calatrava Capital S.A.
calatrava-capital-s-a.description: Calatrava Capital S.A. is a Polish holding company listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. It manages subsidiaries and focuses on analysis, restructuring, financing, and selling or floating companies. Its portfolio includes companies from IT, energy, and fuel sectors.

co-operators.name: Co-operators
co-operators.description: The Co-operators Group Limited is a Canadian insurance co-operative founded in 1945 by farmers in Saskatchewan. Owned by 46 members, it offers multi-line insurance products including auto, home, life, farm, travel, and commercial insurance, as well as investment services.

ceva-inc.name: Ceva, Inc.
ceva-inc.description: Ceva, Inc. is a publicly traded semiconductor and software intellectual property company headquartered in Rockville, Maryland. It develops and licenses signal processing platforms and AI processors for smart edge applications, including wireless connectivity and AI technologies for diverse markets.

centrus-energy.name: Centrus Energy
centrus-energy.description: Centrus Energy Corp. is an American company supplying nuclear fuel for nuclear power plants. It also develops centrifuge technology to produce enriched uranium for commercial, government, and national security uses.

ccb-brasil.name: CCB Brasil
ccb-brasil.description: CCB Brasil, formerly BicBanco, is a mid-sized Brazilian bank founded in 1938 in Juazeiro do Norte. It is headquartered in São Paulo and was acquired by China Construction Bank in 2013 after the founding family sold their shares.

ccl-industries.name: CCL Industries
ccl-industries.description: CCL Industries, Inc. is an American-Canadian company founded in 1951 and described as the world's largest label maker. It operates five divisions and has 154 manufacturing facilities worldwide.

ci-financial.name: CI Financial
ci-financial.description: CI Financial is a Canadian investment management company based in Toronto, Ontario. It provides investment and wealth management services to high net worth retail investors, as well as brokerage and trading services to portfolio managers and institutional investors.

cmc-electronics-inc.name: CMC Electronics Inc.
cmc-electronics-inc.description: CMC Electronics Inc. is a Canadian avionics manufacturer with its main facility in Montreal, Quebec. It also has additional manufacturing locations in Sugar Grove, Illinois, and Reston, Virginia.

calfrac-well-services.name: Calfrac Well Services
calfrac-well-services.description: Calfrac Well Services Ltd. is an oilfield services company operating in Canada, the United States, and Argentina. It provides hydraulic fracturing, coiled tubing, cementing, and other well stimulation services to enhance oil and natural gas production.

cambrex-corporation.name: Cambrex Corporation
cambrex-corporation.description: Cambrex Corporation is a contract manufacturing organization operating in the pharmaceutical industry.

carefusion.name: CareFusion
carefusion.description: CareFusion Corporation was a medical company specializing in reducing medication errors and preventing healthcare-associated infections.

catalyst-paper.name: Catalyst Paper
catalyst-paper.description: Catalyst Paper Corporation is a pulp and paper company based in Richmond, British Columbia, Canada. It operates five pulp and paper mills producing magazine paper and newsprint.

catamaran-corporation.name: Catamaran Corporation
catamaran-corporation.description: Catamaran Corporation, now part of UnitedHealth Group's OptumRx division, provides pharmacy benefit management and medical record keeping services in the United States. It operates independently of government and insurance companies and processes prescription drug claims online.

cedar-realty-trust.name: Cedar Realty Trust
cedar-realty-trust.description: Cedar Realty Trust, Inc. is a real estate investment trust investing in shopping centers, primarily in the Northeastern United States. It is a subsidiary of Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust and owned 19 properties as of December 31, 2022. Its notable property includes The Shoppes at Trexler.

centamin.name: Centamin
centamin.description: Centamin is a gold mining and exploration company whose main operating asset is the Sukari gold mine in Egypt. It is wholly owned by AngloGold Ashanti plc. The company is based in Australia.

chadormalu-mining-and-industrial-company.name: Chadormalu Mining and Industrial Company
chadormalu-mining-and-industrial-company.description: The Chadormalu Mining and Industrial Company was established in June 1992 in Tehran, Iran. It operates in the mining industry, although specific activities are not detailed in the summary.

china-green-agriculture.name: China Green Agriculture
china-green-agriculture.description: China Green Agriculture, Inc. is based in Xi'an, China, and produces humic acid based liquid compound fertilizer. It was the first Chinese company listed on the New York Stock Exchange and NYSE Euronext markets in 2009. The company became public in 2008.

christopher-banks.name: Christopher & Banks
christopher-banks.description: Christopher & Banks, originally Brauns Fashions, is an American retail company specializing in women's clothing for ages 40 to 60. It was originally headquartered in Plymouth, Minnesota, a suburb of Minneapolis.

chrysalis-group-plc.name: Chrysalis Group PLC
chrysalis-group-plc.description: Chrysalis Group was a UK media company founded by Chris Wright and Terry Ellis. It focused on music publishing, recording, artist management, and entertainment product distribution. The music branch included labels such as The Hit Label, Echo, and Papillon Records.

clearwire.name: Clearwire
clearwire.description: Clearwire Corporation was a telecommunications operator providing mobile and fixed wireless broadband services in the US and parts of Europe. Founded from a spin-off in 1998, it moved its headquarters to Bellevue, Washington in 2012.

close-brothers-group.name: Close Brothers Group
close-brothers-group.description: Close Brothers Group plc is a UK merchant banking group offering lending, deposit taking, wealth management, and securities trading services. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

clyde-engineering.name: Clyde Engineering
clyde-engineering.description: Clyde Engineering was an Australian manufacturer specializing in locomotives, rolling stock, and other industrial products.

convatec.name: ConvaTec
convatec.description: Convatec Group plc is a medical products and technologies company based in London, England. It provides products and services in advanced wound care, ostomy care, continence care, and infusion care. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

coresite.name: CoreSite
coresite.description: CoreSite is a subsidiary of American Tower that owns carrier-neutral data centers. It provides colocation and peering services. The company operates in the real estate investment trust sector focused on data center properties.

countrywide.name: Countrywide
countrywide.description: Countrywide is one of the UK's largest integrated property services groups, including residential property surveying and estate agency operations. It operates over 650 offices under more than 50 brands and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Connells Group.

covanta.name: Covanta
covanta.description: Reworld, formerly known as Covanta, is a private energy-from-waste and industrial waste management company headquartered in Florham Park, New Jersey. It operates incineration facilities that generate electricity and metal slag from burning trash. The company charges fees for waste disposal and sells the byproducts of waste incineration.

cranswick-plc.name: Cranswick plc
cranswick-plc.description: Cranswick plc is a United Kingdom-based food producer and supplier specializing in premium, fresh, and added-value food products. The company is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. It operates within the food industry.

crawford-company.name: Crawford & Company
crawford-company.description: Crawford & Company is a claims management firm with over 700 offices across 70 countries. It provides services related to insurance claims management. The company operates in the insurance industry.

crest-nicholson.name: Crest Nicholson
crest-nicholson.description: Crest Nicholson is a British housebuilding company headquartered in Weybridge, Surrey, England. It is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange. The company operates in the house-building industry.

cintra.name: Cintra
cintra.description: Cintra, S.A. is one of the largest private developers of transport infrastructure globally, focusing on toll roads and car parks. It was formerly traded on the Madrid Stock Exchange and part of the IBEX 35 index before being reacquired by Ferrovial in 2009.

cascades.name: Cascades
cascades.description: Cascades Inc. is a Canadian company producing, converting, and marketing packaging and tissue products mainly from recycled fibers. Founded in 1964, it operates over 70 units in North America and employs around 10,000 people.

colt-technology-services.name: Colt Technology Services
colt-technology-services.description: Colt Technology Services Group Limited is a multinational telecommunications company headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Fidelity Investments in 2015. The name Colt stands for City Of London Telecommunications.

charoen-pokphand.name: Charoen Pokphand
charoen-pokphand.description: The Charoen Pokphand Group Company, Ltd. is a Thai conglomerate based in Bangkok. It is Thailand's largest private company and holds the largest privately held Royal Warrant of the Thai Royal Family, with investments in 21 countries.

correios-da-guine-bissau.name: Correios da Guiné-Bissau
correios-da-guine-bissau.description: Correios da Guiné-Bissau is the government-owned postal service company of Guinea-Bissau. Its headquarters is in the former colonial Post Office building in Bissau, and it joined the Universal Postal Union in 1974.

cameroon-radio-television.name: Cameroon radio television
cameroon-radio-television.description: Cameroon Radio Television (CRTV) is a major radio and television broadcasting company based in Cameroon. It operates terrestrial television and radio services across the country. CRTV is a key player in Cameroon's media landscape.

cameroon-red-cross-society.name: Cameroon Red Cross Society
cameroon-red-cross-society.description: The Cameroon Red Cross Society, established on 30 April 1960, is headquartered in Yaoundé. It is led by Léonie Cécile and focuses on emergency and relief efforts within Cameroon.

camtel.name: Camtel
camtel.description: Camtel is Cameroon's national telecommunications and Internet service provider. It is focused on expanding its network, including CDMA access, digitizing telephone exchanges, and deploying optical fiber along key highways between Douala, Yaoundé, Kribi, and Lolodorf.

camair-co.name: Camair-Co
camair-co.description: Camair-Co is the flag carrier airline of Cameroon, headquartered in Douala and operating from Douala International Airport. It succeeded the now-defunct Cameroon Airlines. The airline has struggled financially and currently has most of its aircraft grounded.

cargo-airways-international.name: Cargo Airways International
cargo-airways-international.description: Cargo Airways International was a cargo airline based in Douala, Cameroon. It operated from Douala International Airport as its main base. The airline specialized in cargo transport services.

correios-de-cabo-verde.name: Correios de Cabo Verde
correios-de-cabo-verde.description: Correios de Cabo Verde is the company responsible for postal services in Cape Verde. Its headquarters are located in the city centre of Praia at Rua Cesário Lacerda, nº 2. The company manages mail delivery across the country.

cabo-verde-express.name: Cabo Verde Express
cabo-verde-express.description: Cabo Verde Express is a regional airline headquartered in Espargos, Cape Verde. It operates domestic scheduled and charter flights from Amílcar Cabral International Airport. The airline focuses on regional air transport services.

cih-bank.name: CIH Bank
cih-bank.description: CIH Bank, formerly Crédit Immobilier et Hôtelier, is a Moroccan bank based in Casablanca. Initially focused on real estate and hospitality financing, it has expanded to offer universal banking services to individuals and businesses.

caisse-de-depot-et-de-gestion.name: Caisse de dépôt et de gestion
caisse-de-depot-et-de-gestion.legal_name: Caisse de dépôt et de gestion
caisse-de-depot-et-de-gestion.description: The Caisse de dépôt et de gestion is a state-owned financial institution in Morocco responsible for collecting, protecting, and investing long-term savings. It manages regulated funds and is an institutional investor in sectors like real estate, tourism, and infrastructure through its subsidiaries.

casa-air-service.name: Casa Air Service
casa-air-service.description: Casa Air Service was a Moroccan airline that began offering private air transport services in 1995. Prior to that, it was involved in agricultural air services for 40 years.

cfg-bank.name: CFG Bank
cfg-bank.description: CFG Bank, formerly Casablanca Finance Group, is a Moroccan bank founded in 1992. It was Morocco’s first investment bank and became a universal bank in 2015, offering services to the general public. The bank is listed on the Casablanca Stock Exchange.

chicken-republic.name: Chicken Republic
chicken-republic.description: Chicken Republic is a Nigerian quick-service restaurant chain specializing in chicken-based meals and fast food. Founded in 2004, it is a subsidiary and flagship brand of Food Concepts Plc, headquartered in Lagos. The chain operates primarily in Nigeria and Ghana, including through franchising.

channels-tv.name: Channels TV
channels-tv.description: Channels Television is an independent 24-hour news and media television channel based in Lagos, Nigeria. Founded in 1992, it began broadcasting in 1995 following deregulation of the Nigerian broadcast media. The channel focuses on news and current affairs related to Nigerian domestic issues.

cappa-d-alberto-plc.name: Cappa & D'Alberto PLC
cappa-d-alberto-plc.description: Cappa & D'Alberto LTD is a building and construction company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It was formerly listed on the Nigerian Stock Exchange but was delisted in 2009, with shares traded over the counter.

chi-limited.name: Chi Limited
chi-limited.description: CHI Limited, also known as Chivita|Hollandia, is a Nigerian company producing locally made food and beverage products. Founded in 1980, it leads in fruit juice, dairy, and snack categories in Nigeria and Africa.

chanchangi-airlines.name: Chanchangi Airlines
chanchangi-airlines.description: Chanchangi Airlines Nigeria Limited was a privately owned airline headquartered in Kaduna, Nigeria. It operated scheduled domestic passenger services with its main base at Murtala Mohammed International Airport, Lagos, and hubs in Kaduna, Abuja, and Port Harcourt.

c-i-leasing-group-plc.name: C&I Leasing Group PLC
c-i-leasing-group-plc.description: C&I Leasing Group PLC is a Nigerian public limited maritime company formed in 1990 and listed on the Nigerian stock exchange since 1997. It operates through three business units: fleet management, outsourcing, and marine vessel operations.

centenary-bank-uganda.name: Centenary Bank Uganda
centenary-bank-uganda.description: Centenary Bank, also known as Centenary Rural Development Bank Limited, is a commercial bank in Uganda. It is licensed by the Bank of Uganda, the country's central bank and national banking regulator. The bank operates within Uganda's financial services sector.

cairo-international-bank.name: Cairo International Bank
cairo-international-bank.description: Cairo Bank Uganda Limited, formerly Cairo International Bank, is a commercial bank in Uganda licensed by the Bank of Uganda. It is a subsidiary of the Egypt-based Banque du Caire Group.

commercial-bank-of-ethiopia.name: Commercial Bank of Ethiopia
commercial-bank-of-ethiopia.description: The Commercial Bank of Ethiopia is the largest commercial bank in Ethiopia, with a vast network of branches across the country. It employs over 35,000 people and holds a significant share of deposits and loans in Ethiopia's banking sector.

claro-brasil.name: Claro Brasil
claro-brasil.description: Claro Brasil is a telecommunications operator in Brazil offering mobile, satellite television, fixed, and broadband services. It was formed in 2003 through the merger of six regional operators including Americel and ATL. The company serves the Brazilian telecommunications market.

copa-studio.name: Copa Studio
copa-studio.description: Copa Studio is a Brazilian animation studio based in Rio de Janeiro, founded in 2009. It produces animated series such as Trunk Train and Jorel's Brother for Cartoon Network, as well as movies and television specials. The studio is known for its work in children's animation.

clara.name: Clara
clara.description: Clara is a financial technology company headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. It offers corporate credit cards, digital payment accounts, and expense management software for businesses in Latin America. Clara operates in the fintech sector.

comil.name: Comil
comil.description: Comil Carrocerias e Onibus is a Brazilian bus and coach manufacturer established in 1985 and based in Erechim, Rio Grande do Sul. It also operates a factory in Mexico and exports products to 29 countries. The company also manufactures grain storage buildings and equipment.

chamonix.name: Chamonix
chamonix.description: Chamonix NG Cars is a Brazilian automobile manufacturer based in São Paulo, founded in 1981. The company was formerly located in Jarinu and was founded by Milton Masteguin and Chuck Beck.

caemi.name: Caemi
caemi.description: Caemi Mineração e Metallurgia S.A. was a major Brazilian mining holding company that merged into Vale in 2006. The name Caemi stands for Auxiliary Company of Mining Companies.

carbuss-industria-de-carrocerias-catarin.name: Carbuss - Indústria de Carrocerias Catarinense Ltda.
carbuss-industria-de-carrocerias-catarin.legal_name: Carbuss - Indústria de Carrocerias Catarinense Ltda.
carbuss-industria-de-carrocerias-catarin.description: Carbuss - Indústria de Carrocerias Catarinense Ltda. is a Brazilian bus manufacturer based in Joinville, operating on premises formerly owned by the bankrupt bus maker Busscar.

casas-bahia.name: Casas Bahia
casas-bahia.description: Casas Bahia is a Brazilian retail chain specializing in furniture and home appliances, founded in 1952 in São Caetano do Sul, São Paulo by Samuel Klein. The Klein family controls Via Varejo, which owns the store.

casa-video.name: Casa & Video
casa-video.description: Casa & Vídeo is a department store chain founded in Rio de Janeiro in 1988, with over 220 stores in four southeastern Brazilian states as of 2025.

cutrale.name: Cutrale
cutrale.description: Sucocitrico Cutrale is a Brazilian company based in Araraquara, São Paulo, that produces oranges, orange juice, and orange by-products. Founded in 1967 by José Cutrale Jr., the company remains controlled by the Cutrale family.

cinedia.name: Cinédia
cinedia.description: Cinédia was a Brazilian film studio established in Rio de Janeiro in 1930. It operated continuously until 1951, contributing to the Brazilian film industry during that period.

copersucar.name: Copersucar
copersucar.description: Copersucar is the world's largest sugar and ethanol company based in Brazil. It operates numerous mills across several states and is a major exporter and trader of sugar and ethanol globally.

companhia-brasileira-de-cartuchos.name: Companhia Brasileira de Cartuchos
companhia-brasileira-de-cartuchos.description: Companhia Brasileira de Cartuchos (CBC) is a Brazilian ammunition and weapons manufacturer. The company is based in Ribeirão Pires, São Paulo, Brazil.

centro-de-tecnologia-canavieira.name: Centro de Tecnologia Canavieira
centro-de-tecnologia-canavieira.description: Centro de Tecnologia Canavieira (CTC) is the largest sugarcane technology center in the world, headquartered in Piracicaba, São Paulo. Founded in 1969, it serves sugarcane producers and processors across Brazil and is majority owned by Copersucar and Raízen.

citrosuco.name: Citrosuco
citrosuco.description: Citrosuco is the largest global producer of orange juice concentrate, headquartered in Matão, Brazil. It holds significant market shares in Brazil and worldwide and is a subsidiary of the Votorantim Group. The company also produces orange by-products like essential oils and animal feed.

conrad-editora.name: Conrad Editora
conrad-editora.description: Conrad Editora is a Brazilian book publishing company known for distributing manga and manhwa in Brazilian Portuguese. It operates within the publishing industry in Brazil.

colcci.name: Colcci
colcci.description: Colcci is a Brazilian fashion company specializing in clothing and accessories for men and women. It offers products such as jeans, t-shirts, dresses, skirts, and shoes. Colcci is one of the leading fashion brands in Brazil with a strong presence domestically and internationally.

cupet.name: CUPET
cupet.description: CUPET is Cuba's largest oil company, owned and operated by the Cuban government. It is involved in petroleum extraction, refining, and distribution. Together with CIMEX, it operates a chain of filling stations selling gasoline in convertible pesos.

cubana-de-aviacion.name: Cubana de Aviación
cubana-de-aviacion.description: Cubana de Aviación is the flag carrier and largest airline of Cuba, founded in 1929. It has its headquarters in Havana and its home base at José Martí International Airport. The airline has been wholly owned by the Cuban government since 1959.

chicken-licken.name: Chicken Licken
chicken-licken.description: Chicken Licken is a South African fast-food fried chicken restaurant chain. It is recognized as the largest non-American-owned fried chicken franchise in the world.

checkers.name: Checkers
checkers.description: Checkers is a South African supermarket retailer operating across Southern Africa. It is owned by Shoprite, a sister retailer and discount chain.

ceres-fruit-juices.name: Ceres Fruit Juices
ceres-fruit-juices.description: Ceres Fruit Juices Pty Ltd, trading as The Ceres Beverage Company, is a beverage company based in Ceres, South Africa. It produces fruit juice and other fruit-based products and is a subsidiary of Pioneer Foods.

cell-c.name: Cell C
cell-c.description: Cell C Limited is a South African mobile telecoms operator headquartered in Sandton, Gauteng. It is the fourth-largest mobile provider in South Africa by customer base as of 2026. The company operates in the mobile phone industry.

civair.name: Civair
civair.description: Civair is an aircraft charter operator based in Cape Town, South Africa. Its core business is operating helicopter charters. The company operates in the airline industry.

cemair.name: CemAir
cemair.description: CemAir is a South African airline headquartered in Johannesburg. Founded in 2005, it operates scheduled domestic flights across South Africa and regional services within Africa. The airline serves both domestic and regional markets.

command-airways.name: Command Airways
command-airways.description: Command Airways was an airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It operated scheduled services from 1977 to 1980 and continued with non-scheduled services thereafter until it ceased operations.

capenature.name: CapeNature
capenature.description: CapeNature is a governmental organisation responsible for maintaining wilderness areas and public nature reserves in Western Cape Province, South Africa. It focuses on environmental conservation within the region.

cevital.name: Cevital
cevital.description: Cevital is the largest private conglomerate in Algeria with interests in agri-food, retail, industry, and services. Founded by Issad Rebrab, it is headquartered in Kouba, Algeria, and is a founding member of the Desertec project.

cma-sampo.name: Cma Sampo
cma-sampo.description: Cma Sampo Spa is an Algerian joint venture specializing in the development of agricultural vehicles. Created in 2010, it is based in Sidi Bel Abbès and owned by Construction Agricultural Equipment (CMA), the Algerian firm PMAT, and Finnish partners. The company was formed after an agreement between the Algerian brand CMA and Finnish group Sampo-Rosenlew.

cebon.name: Cebon
cebon.description: Cebon is an Algerian foods company producing products under the El Mordjene brand. It is best known for its hazelnut spreads, which gained viral popularity in France in 2024.

credit-foncier-d-algerie-et-de-tunisie.name: Crédit foncier d'Algérie et de Tunisie
credit-foncier-d-algerie-et-de-tunisie.legal_name: Crédit foncier d'Algérie et de Tunisie
credit-foncier-d-algerie-et-de-tunisie.industry: Financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
credit-foncier-d-algerie-et-de-tunisie.description: Crédit Foncier d'Algérie et de Tunisie was a French colonial bank operating in Algeria and Tunisia. It provided financial services excluding insurance and pension funding.

correos-de-chile.name: Correos de Chile
correos-de-chile.description: Correos de Chile is a Chilean state-owned enterprise providing mailing, money transfer, and courier services nationally and internationally. It also fulfills the functions of the Universal Postal Service in Chile.

codelco.name: Codelco
codelco.description: Codelco is a Chilean state-owned mining company and the largest copper mining company in the world. It operates in the mining sector focusing on copper extraction.

copesa.name: Copesa
copesa.description: Copesa is a significant Chilean media conglomerate controlled by businessman Álvaro Saieh. It operates in the mass media industry in Chile.

cnn-chile.name: CNN Chile
cnn-chile.description: Cable News Network Chile is a Chilean pay television news channel and news website launched in 2008. It was originally a joint venture between VTR Chile and WarnerMedia. The channel is based in Santiago, Chile.

colun.name: Colun
colun.description: Cooperativa Agrícola y Lechera de La Unión Limitada, known as Colún, is a Chilean dairy cooperative based in La Unión. As of 2011, it was the second largest dairy company in Chile after Soprole.

chilean-red-cross.name: Chilean Red Cross
chilean-red-cross.description: The Chilean Red Cross Society was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Santiago. It was incorporated by law in 1923 and its volunteers respond to natural disasters such as volcano eruptions in Chile.

correo-oficial-de-la-republica-argentina.name: Correo Oficial de la República Argentina
correo-oficial-de-la-republica-argentina.legal_name: Correo Oficial de la República Argentina
correo-oficial-de-la-republica-argentina.hq: Buenos Aires Central Post Office, Argentina
correo-oficial-de-la-republica-argentina.description: The Official Post Service of the Argentine Republic is a state-owned company covering postal services in Argentina. It is a S.A. under the country's Office of the Cabinet Chief. The company operates in the mail industry.

c5n.name: C5N
c5n.description: Canal 5 Noticias (C5N) is an Argentine pay television news channel launched on August 6, 2007. It operates in the news and communication sector in Argentina.

cicare-helicopteros.name: Cicaré Helicópteros
cicare-helicopteros.description: Cicaré S.A. is an Argentine helicopter manufacturer founded in the 1970s in Saladillo, Buenos Aires Province. It developed several prototypes, including one for the Argentine Air Force, and achieved success with the CH-7 light sporting helicopter in the 1990s.

chocolate-aguila.name: Chocolate Águila
chocolate-aguila.description: Chocolate Águila is an Argentine chocolate brand owned by Grupo Arcor. It originated from Saint Hermanos S.A., established in 1880, and was known for its chocolate bars under the Águila tradename.

cris-morena-group.name: Cris Morena Group
cris-morena-group.description: Cris Morena Group is a Buenos Aires-based production company founded in 2002 by Cris Morena. It specializes in youth programming and also develops ancillary businesses such as CDs, magazines, licenses, musicals, and theatrical productions. It is a major production company in Argentina.

ceatsa.name: CEATSA
ceatsa.description: CEATSA is an Argentine high technology testing company providing environmental testing services to satellite, aeronautics, electronics, automotive, defense, and energy industries. It is jointly owned by government-owned ARSAT and public company INVAP. The company operates in the aerospace industry.

credit-bank-of-peru.name: Credit Bank of Peru
credit-bank-of-peru.description: Banco de Crédito del Perú is the largest bank in Peru by total assets and the main subsidiary of Credicorp, the country's largest financial holding company. It provides integrated financial services across Peru.

caja-trujillo.name: Caja Trujillo
caja-trujillo.description: Caja Trujillo is a Peruvian bank based in Trujillo city, focusing on financial services for entrepreneurs in the SME sector. It is the largest financial company in its region with branches across coastal and highland areas of Peru.

conviasa.name: Conviasa
conviasa.description: Línea Aérea Conviasa is the flag carrier and largest airline of Venezuela, headquartered at Simón Bolívar International Airport near Caracas. It operates domestic and international flights to the Caribbean and South America. Conviasa is noted for establishing routes for political reasons.

cerveceria-polar.name: Cervecería Polar
cerveceria-polar.description: Empresas Polar, also known as Cervecería Polar, is a Venezuelan corporation founded in 1941 in Caracas. It started as a brewery and is the largest and best known brewery in Venezuela. The company has diversified into food processing and packaging, serving markets domestically and abroad.

central-madeirense.name: Central Madeirense
central-madeirense.description: Central Madeirense is a Venezuelan supermarket chain founded in 1949 by families from Madeira, Portugal. Its first store was in Caracas, and at its peak, it operated 53 stores in 38 cities, becoming the largest chain in the country.

compania-anonima-venezolana-de-industria.name: Compañía Anónima Venezolana de Industrias Militares
compania-anonima-venezolana-de-industria.legal_name: Compañía Anónima Venezolana de Industrias Militares
compania-anonima-venezolana-de-industria.description: CAVIM (Compañía Anónima Venezolana de Industrias Militares) is a Venezuelan state-owned firearms manufacturer established on April 29, 1975.

cantv.name: CANTV
cantv.description: CANTV is the state-run telephone and internet service provider in Venezuela. Founded in 1930, it was privatized in 1991 and re-nationalized in 2007. It is the largest telecommunications provider in the country.

caricom-airways.name: Caricom Airways
caricom-airways.description: Caricom Airways was a regional airline headquartered in Paramaribo, Suriname. It primarily operated charter flights from Zorg en Hoop Airport to destinations within Suriname's interior, the Caribbean, and northern Brazil. The airline served regional travel needs before ceasing operations.

coltel.name: COLTEL
coltel.description: Telefónica Colombia is the largest telecommunications company in Colombia, established in 1947 by Mariano Ospina Pérez. It is owned by the Spanish company Telefónica and the Colombian government, which holds a 32.5% stake. The company is headquartered in Bogotá.

cable-noticias.name: Cable Noticias
cable-noticias.description: Cable Noticias is a Colombian 24-hour cable television news channel owned by Global Media, based in Medellín. Alberto Federico Ravell purchased the channel in 2011, and it operates out of Bogotá, Colombia.

cotecmar.name: COTECMAR
cotecmar.description: COTECMAR is a Colombian state-owned defense, shipbuilding, and engineering company. It serves the Ministry of National Defense of Colombia and other customers, operating major facilities in Cartagena de Indias.

crepes-waffles.name: Crepes & Waffles
crepes-waffles.description: Crepes & Waffles is the third largest restaurant chain in Colombia. It was founded by university students working on a project and operates in the gastronomy sector.

colombia-movil.name: Colombia Móvil
colombia-movil.description: Colombia Móvil S.A., marketed as Tigo, is the third largest mobile phone company in Colombia headquartered in Bogotá. It provides telecommunications services nationally and internationally under the Tigo and Orbitel brands.

central-charter-de-colombia.name: Central Charter de Colombia
central-charter-de-colombia.description: Central Aerospace is a Colombian charter airline and aerospace services company based at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá. It provides both air transport and aerospace-related services. The company operates within Colombia's aviation sector.

corporacion-minera-de-bolivia.name: Corporación Minera de Bolivia
corporacion-minera-de-bolivia.description: The Mining Corporation of Bolivia is a state-owned enterprise managing national mining operations. Established in 1952, it was the largest state company after the Bolivian National Revolution. After inactivity during the 1980s, it was reactivated in 2006 and remains important in Bolivia's economy.

caribbean-airlines.name: Caribbean Airlines
caribbean-airlines.description: Caribbean Airlines Limited is the state-owned flag carrier of Trinidad and Tobago and Jamaica, headquartered in Piarco. It operates flights across the Caribbean, North America, and South America from its base at Piarco International Airport. It is the largest airline in the Caribbean by employment.

carib-brewery.name: Carib Brewery
carib-brewery.description: The Carib Brewery Limited is a Trinidad and Tobago-based company producing Carib and Stag beers along with shandy products. Its main brewery is in Champs Fleurs, Trinidad, with additional breweries in Saint Kitts and Nevis, Grenada, and a US affiliate in Florida.

cinemateca-uruguaya.name: Cinemateca Uruguaya
cinemateca-uruguaya.description: Cinemateca Uruguaya is a non-profit cinematheque based in Montevideo, Uruguay, established in 1952. It supports the cultural development of cinema and art, and is a member of international film archive organizations.

camara-uruguaya-de-productores-de-fonogr.name: Cámara Uruguaya de Productores de Fonogramas y Videogramas
camara-uruguaya-de-productores-de-fonogr.legal_name: Cámara Uruguaya de Productores de Fonogramas y Videogramas
camara-uruguaya-de-productores-de-fonogr.description: Cámara Uruguaya de Productores de Fonogramas y Videogramas, also known as Cámara Uruguaya del Disco, is a non-profit organization established in 1960. It administers the economic rights of Uruguayan phonographic producers and is linked to the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry.

central-romana.name: Central Romana
central-romana.description: Central Romana Corporation, Ltd. is an agro-industrial and tourism company based in the Dominican Republic. It operates in agriculture and tourism sectors within the country.

corporacion-estatal-de-radio-y-televisio.name: Corporación Estatal de Radio y Televisión
corporacion-estatal-de-radio-y-televisio.legal_name: Corporación Estatal de Radio y Televisión
corporacion-estatal-de-radio-y-televisio.description: Corporación Estatal de Radio y Televisión is a public radio and television network operating from Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. It is owned by the Dominican government and broadcasts nationwide on channel 4.

claro-republica-dominicana.name: Claro República Dominicana
claro-republica-dominicana.description: Claro Dominicana, known as Claro, is the largest telecommunications company in the Dominican Republic. It provides local, long-distance, wireless voice, Internet, and IPTV services to millions of customers.

caribair.name: Caribair
caribair.description: Caribair was an airline based in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. It operated scheduled services within the Dominican Republic and Haiti, as well as charter and air taxi flights throughout the Caribbean.

credit-agricole-egypt-bank-s-a-e.name: Credit Agricole - Egypt Bank (S.A.E.)
credit-agricole-egypt-bank-s-a-e.description: Crédit Agricole Egypt is a medium-sized Egyptian bank and subsidiary of Crédit Agricole. It offers financial services to individuals, businesses, and the rural sector, operating approximately 86 branches and serving over 393,000 customers across Egypt.

cook-door.name: Cook Door
cook-door.description: Cook Door is a chain of fast food restaurants based in Cairo, Egypt. It is one of the country's notable fast food chains alongside Smiley's Grill and Mo'men.

city-centre-alexandria.name: City Centre Alexandria
city-centre-alexandria.description: City Centre Alexandria is a shopping mall located in Alexandria, Egypt, opened in January 2003. Developed and managed by Majid Al Futtaim Properties, it houses over 160 retail stores including anchor tenants like Debenhams, Zara, Max, H&M, and a Carrefour Hypermarket.

cairo-aviation.name: Cairo Aviation
cairo-aviation.description: Cairo Aviation was a former charter airline based in Cairo, Egypt. It no longer operates.

comme-il-faut.name: Comme il faut
comme-il-faut.description: Compagnie des Tabacs Comme Il Faut, S.A. is an international tobacco company based in Port-au-Prince, Haiti. Owned by Luckett, Inc., it is the only cigarette maker in Haiti with its Comme Il Faut and Point brands marketed locally.

correios-de-angola.name: Correios de Angola
correios-de-angola.description: Empresa Nacional de Correios e Telégrafos de Angola, operating as Correios de Angola, is the state-owned company responsible for postal services in Angola.

crdb-bank.name: CRDB Bank
crdb-bank.description: CRDB Bank Plc is a commercial bank in Tanzania licensed by the Bank of Tanzania. As of September 2022, it was the largest commercial bank in the country.

coastal-aviation.name: Coastal Aviation
coastal-aviation.description: Coastal Aviation operates out of Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. It provides air services within Tanzania and to neighboring countries such as Kenya and Rwanda.

central-african-red-cross-society.name: Central African Red Cross Society
central-african-red-cross-society.description: The Central African Red Cross Society (CRCA) was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Bangui, Central African Republic. It operates in the emergency and relief sector.

compagnie-des-phosphates-de-gafsa.name: Compagnie des phosphates de Gafsa
compagnie-des-phosphates-de-gafsa.description: Compagnie des phosphates de Gafsa (CPG) is a Tunisian phosphate mining company based in Gafsa, established during the French colonial era. It merged with Groupe chimique tunisien in 1994 to form CPG-CGT. The company was once the fifth largest phosphate producer globally.

claro-tv.name: Claro TV
claro-tv.description: Embratel TVsat Telecomunicações S.A. operates pay television services in Latin America under the brands Embratel and Claro. It uses Star One C4 satellite and a DTH transmission system in Ku Band with encrypted channels. The company authenticates subscribers via conditional access cards.

cablemas.name: Cablemás
cablemas.description: Cablemás was a Mexican regional telecommunications company owned by Grupo Televisa. It offered a triple play service including subscription television, phone line, and broadband internet in a single package. The company was headquartered in Mexico City.

camara-nacional-de-la-industria-de-radio.name: Cámara Nacional de la Industria de Radio y Televisión
camara-nacional-de-la-industria-de-radio.legal_name: Cámara Nacional de la Industria de Radio y Televisión
camara-nacional-de-la-industria-de-radio.description: The National Chamber of the Radio and Television Industry (CIRT) is the broadcasters' association of Mexico, representing all commercial broadcasters in the country. It is led by José Antonio García Herrera since 2021. The organization serves as a key industry association within Mexico's broadcasting sector.

consejo-mundial-de-lucha-libre.name: Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre
consejo-mundial-de-lucha-libre.description: Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre is a Mexican professional wrestling promotion headquartered in Mexico City. Founded in 1933 as Empresa Mexicana de Lucha Libre by Salvador Lutteroth, it is the oldest professional wrestling promotion still in existence.

casas-geo.name: Casas GEO
casas-geo.description: Casas GEO was a leading housing developer in Mexico and one of the largest in Latin America. The company was involved in design, development, construction, marketing, sales, and delivery of mainly low-income housing across 52 cities in 16 Mexican states.

cinepolis.name: Cinépolis
cinepolis.description: Cinépolis is a Mexico-based international movie theater chain and the largest cineplex chain in Mexico and Latin America. It operates 427 theaters in 97 cities and owns cinemas in several countries including Spain, India, and the United States.

cinemex.name: Cinemex
cinemex.description: Cadena Mexicana de Exhibición S.A. de C.V., known as Cinemex, is a Mexican cinema chain operating multiplex theaters in multiple cities including Mexico City, Guadalajara, and Monterrey.

compartamos-banco-icr.name: Compartamos Banco ICR
compartamos-banco-icr.description: Compartamos Banco is a Mexican bank headquartered in Mexico City and the largest microfinance bank in Latin America. Founded in 1990, it serves more than 2.5 million clients.

calafiaairlines.name: CALAFIAAIRLINES
calafiaairlines.description: Calafia Airlines was a Mexican regional airline based in Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur. It operated regular and charter flights mainly within the Baja California Peninsula and Northern Mexico. The airline was named after Calafia, the legendary warrior queen of the island of California.

cotair.name: COTAIR
cotair.description: COTAIR was an airline based in Cotonou, Benin, established in 2008. It operated scheduled domestic flights and regional charter flights in West Africa, with its main base at Cotonou Cadjehoun Airport. The airline ceased operations on December 31, 2009.

comoros-red-crescent.name: Comoros Red Crescent
comoros-red-crescent.description: The Comoros Red Crescent Society was founded in 1982 and recognized by the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement in 2005. Its headquarters is in Moroni, with regional branches on the Comoros islands. It manages relief supplies and has thousands of members and volunteers.

comores-aviation-international.name: Comores Aviation International
comores-aviation-international.description: Comores Aviation International was the flag carrier airline of the Comoros, operating domestic scheduled services and charters mainly to tourist destinations in southern and eastern Africa. Its main base was Prince Said Ibrahim International Airport in Moroni, with a hub at Ouani Airport.

congolese-posts-and-savings-company.name: Congolese Posts and Savings Company
congolese-posts-and-savings-company.description: The Congolese Posts and Savings Company is a government-owned postal corporation in the Republic of Congo, created in 2001. It operates forty-eight post offices mainly in major cities, while many private companies also provide postal services, often without government permission.

congolese-plantation-workers-art-league.name: Congolese Plantation Workers Art League
congolese-plantation-workers-art-league.hq: Lusanga, Democratic Republic of the Congo
congolese-plantation-workers-art-league.description: The Congolese Plantation Workers Art League (CATPC) is an art cooperative founded in 2014 by plantation workers and environmental activist René Ngongo. It is based in Lusanga, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and built an art center named White Cube Lusanga in 2017.

commercial-bank-of-congo.name: Commercial Bank of Congo
commercial-bank-of-congo.industry: Financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
commercial-bank-of-congo.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
commercial-bank-of-congo.description: The Commercial Bank of Congo, formerly known as Banque du Congo Belge and later Banque Commerciale Du Congo (BCDC), operated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from colonial times until 2020. It was acquired by Equity Group Holdings and became part of Equity Banque Commerciale du Congo.

compagnie-africaine-d-aviation.name: Compagnie Africaine d'Aviation
compagnie-africaine-d-aviation.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
compagnie-africaine-d-aviation.description: Compagnie Africaine d'Aviation is a regional airline based in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Its main base is N'djili Airport in Kinshasa. The airline operates within the region.

ceiba-intercontinental.name: CEIBA Intercontinental
ceiba-intercontinental.description: CEIBA Intercontinental is an airline headquartered in Malabo, Equatorial Guinea. It is based at Malabo International Airport. The airline operates in the region from its main base.

cronos-airlines.name: Cronos Airlines
cronos-airlines.description: Cronos Airlines is a regional airline headquartered in Malabo, Equatorial Guinea. It operates passenger and cargo services within Equatorial Guinea and to Cameroon, Benin, and Nigeria. The airline is banned from flying in the European Union.
